jobs.title: Senior .NET Ontwikkelaar
jobs.description:
AI schrijft steeds meer van onze code. Daarom zoekt BKR een ervaren .NET-ontwikkelaar die ziet wanneer die code klopt en wanneer niet.

Je komt in het team Development, dat de ICT-oplossingen van BKR van begin tot eind bouwt. BKR heeft Development, infra- en Cloud-architectuur, testautomatisering en business informatie analyse in huis. De teams werken T-shaped: je hebt je eigen specialisme en schakelt makkelijk met de andere disciplines.

Je werkt in een BizDevOps-team volgens Agile en Scrum, samen met business informatie analisten, testspecialisten en operations. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt onze kernapplicaties in C# en .NET, met SQL Server en Entity Framework. Voor moderne webinterfaces zetten we in op Blazor. Onze applicaties draaien in een moderne Azure Cloud-omgeving, waarbij CI/CD en geautomatiseerde deployments de standaard zijn. Denk aan EVA, de Externe Verwijzings Applicatie waarmee BKR fraudepreventie faciliteert voor de NVB en VFN, en VIS, het Verificatie Identificatie Systeem waarmee organisaties identiteits- en reisdocumenten op geldigheid controleren.

AI-tools horen bij het werk. Je gebruikt onder meer GitHub Copilot om sneller te bouwen. Het verschil zit erin dat je snapt wat er uitkomt en waar het misgaat. Jij houdt overzicht over de architectuur en bewaakt de kwaliteit.

Wat je gaat doen

Softwarecomponenten bouwen op basis van requirement-, ontwerp- en architectuurdocumenten
Code schrijven voor system services, applicaties en moderne Blazor webinterfaces in C# en .NET
Aanpassingen integreren in bestaande applicaties
Onze CI/CD deployment pipelines inrichten, optimaliseren en onderhouden
Applicaties deployen, monitoren en beheren binnen de Azure Cloud-omgeving
Unit- en integratietesten uitvoeren en issues oplossen
Tweedelijns incident- en problemsupport leveren
Meedraaien in refinements, sprint planningen, reviews en retrospectives
AI inzetten waar het helpt, zonder het overzicht te verliezen

Wat we van je vragen

HBO werk- en denkniveau
5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als .NET-ontwikkelaar met C#, SQL Server en Entity Framework
Ervaring met Azure Cloud-architectuur en het opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD deployment pipelines (bijvoorbeeld via Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions)
Ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties in Blazor is een pre
Thuis in Agile, Scrum en het werken in BizDevOps-teams
Je werkt dagelijks met AI-coding assistants en weet waar hun grenzen liggen
Je blijft leren, juist nu AI veel werk overneemt. Vragen we hoe je jezelf scherp houdt en waar je je kennis vandaan haalt, dan heb je daar een goed antwoord op
Een ontwikkelaar die zijn mond opendoet. Je spreekt tegen als iets niet klopt en je vertaalt technische keuzes naar taal die het management snapt
Je hebt oog voor informatiebeveiliging. Bij ons hoort dat erbij, want we beheren gevoelige data
Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is een vereiste. Onze voertaal is Nederlands.

Wat we bieden

Een salaris tot € 5.600 bruto per maand (schaal 6, functie Developer) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 1 fte
Een 13e maand
Een opleidingsbudget
Een employee benefits budget (EBB) voor bijvoorbeeld een fiets of sportschool
Standplaats Tiel

Over BKR

Stichting BKR is een databedrijf zonder winstoogmerk dat zich inzet voor de financiële gezondheid van Nederland. Wij beheren de kredietregistratie: alle kredietaanbieders melden hun leningen bij ons. Die data gebruiken kredietaanbieders, gemeenten en overheden om verantwoorde beslissingen te nemen. Daarnaast faciliteren we fraudepreventie- en identiteitsdiensten voor de financiële sector. BKR is opgericht in 1965 en telt circa 115 medewerkers in Tiel.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Eerst de feiten.

Gewoon een goed salaris tussen de €3.050 en €4.962.
Mobiliteitsvergoeding of auto van de zaak.
26 offline vakantiedagen
Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.
Thuiswerken? Natuurlijk!

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende .NET developer vacature in Zwolle waar je werkt met Azure, C# en moderne development stacks? Dan zit je hier goed.
p.s. ben jij een Senior .NET Developer? Ook dan hebben we ruimte voor jou!

Dit ga jij doen.

Sta jij momenteel stil of ben je toe aan een nieuwe stap in jouw carrière als .NET developer? Ben je op zoek naar een inhoudelijke developer vacature met doorgroeimogelijkheden, verdieping of juist verbreding in je stack, meer diversiteit in projecten of nieuwe verantwoordelijkheden? Met een team van gelijkgestemden waar jij op terug kunt vallen, mee kunt sparren en van kunt leren? It’s never to late to be an Arcadian. Join us.
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare .NET-applicaties in Azure voor A-klanten in Zwolle en omgeving. Binnen deze .NET developer vacature bouw je aan toekomstbestendige software voor organisaties die willen versnellen.
Als Arcadian werk je voor én met onze klanten aan innovatieve projecten. Voor jou is elk project een nieuwe uitdagende puzzel. Of het nu 1.000, 10.000 of 100.000 stukjes zijn. Jij bijt je vast in het project, hebt focus op het creëren van business value en zet door jouw herkenbare drive en overtuiging een superstrakke en doordachte .NET applicatie neer. Robuust, stabiel en schaalbaar. You name it. You create it.
Dat jij schone en toetsbare code kan schrijven op het .NET platform is voor jou een understatement. Net als (bestaande) code beoordelen, herstructureren, debuggen en testen. It’s part of the job.
Soepel meewegen in Agile Development teams en aanhaken bij andere disciplines uit het team? Dat doe jij net zo makkelijk. Het resultaat. Dat hebben jullie voor ogen.
Met jouw heldere blik zie je hoe het moet en wat er kan. Van meedenken tot advies over implementatie en technische haalbaarheid. De klant kan op jou bouwen.
Naast consultancy ben je ook een coach voor Arcady-developers. Je begeleidt afstudeerders, zorgt ervoor dat collega’s goed worden ingewerkt op een project en deelt actief je kennis.
Last but not least. Jezelf blijven ontwikkelen. Groeien als professional en als mens. Dat wil jij dan ook maar al te graag. Wij helpen je daarbij.

Over Arcady.

Wij zijn Arcady. Een agile softwareclub in Zwolle waar meer dan 50 beresterke Arcadians dagelijks organisaties in een stroomversnelling brengen.
De digitale wereld verandert razendsnel. Als Microsoft Solutions Partner helpen wij organisaties om daarin mee te bewegen. Slim, effectief en met een flinke dosis energie. Dat doen we met high performance teams vol specialistische kennis en ondernemerszin.
Onze Arcadians bouwen ‘next-level’ softwareoplossingen die de time-to-market verkorten en het kennisniveau bij opdrachtgevers vergroten. A-klanten als Uitgekookt, Niverplast, Hogeschool Windesheim en The Learning Network hebben we al geholpen in hun digitale transformatie. En ja, daar zijn we trots op. Net als op onze zesde FD Gazellen Award. Een prijs voor de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Nederland. Een mooie bevestiging dat onze aanpak werkt.
Positieve energie, fun en ondernemend zijn: dat maakt Arcady bijzonder. We houden van gezelligheid met collega’s, maar ook van groeien en winnen. Als team én als individu. Want de beste versie van jezelf worden, daar helpen we je graag bij.

Dit ben en kan jij.

Fluent spoken and written Dutch is a requirement for this position

Jij bent een .NET Developer met Arcady-DNA. Dan kan je dus heel wat. Hartstikke veel zelfs. Toch wil je nog meer leren, nog beter worden. Continu. En dat wat je al weet, deel je met je collega’s. Want als jij vindt dat het beter kan, dan mag (moet) iedereen je mening en ideeën horen. Houden we van.
Verder:
Heb jij tenminste 3 jaar ontwikkelervaring als .NET Developer
Je hebt kennis van het .NET platform op basis van C#, kan webapplicaties schrijven met ASP.NET en kan de applicaties hosten op Azure.
Zo goed als je de stacks kent, weet je ook alles van TDD, CI/CD en het voorkomen van incidenten.
Weet je iets niet? Dan graaf jij net zo lang door tot jíj de expert bent. En die kennis deel je weer in de organisatie of in een blog. Dat zou cool zijn. En is ook nog ’s heel Arcady.

What's in it for you?

Behoorlijk wat. Bij Arcady gaan we altijd voor beter en een schepje meer. Wat dacht je van:
Een fijn salaris tussen de €3.050 en €4.962 op basis van ervaring.
Een winstdelingsuitkering.
26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Een uitstekende pensioensregeling.
Een opleidingsbudget van €2.500 en 5 studiedagen per jaar.

Wacht, er is meer.
Een mobiliteitsvergoeding of een leasebudget (v.a. €835 per maand) inclusief tankpas.
Een ruim hardware budget (€3.500) voor een laptop, smartphone en accessoires naar keuze.
De vrijheid om hybride te werken.
Je werk versnellen met GitHub Copilot van de zaak.
We geloven in kennis delen en toepassen: met een Knowledge Officer en AI Officer maken we leren en AI praktisch en delen we onze kennis via meetups, DevSessions en talks (info over werken met AI: scroll verder!)

Nee echt, er is nóg meer:
Werken aan uitdagende projecten bij de gaafste A-klanten in de regio.
Gelijkgestemden om mee te sparren en kennis te delen.
Een gaaf kantoor in hartje Zwolle met de lekkerste koffie en cappuccino en Nintendo Switch.
Relaxte informele werksfeer met knetterfijne collega’s.
Offline-time op de vrijdagmiddag bij de Barcady.
Een duidelijk groeipad waarin je blijft groeien in tech en als professional. Met focus op tech- en human skills, begeleiding van ervaren Tech Leads en People Managers en volop ruimte om stap voor stap meer impact te maken. Ontdek hier hoe jij blijft groeien bij Arcady.

Dit was het wel zo’n beetje. Voor nu.

jobs.title: Junior AI Software Engineer (C#)
jobs.description:
Voor een innovatieve organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een Junior .NET Developer die enthousiast wordt van AI en nieuwe technologie. Deze scale-up heeft een intelligent dataplatform ontwikkeld voor de zachtfruitsector. Met behulp van IoT-sensoren, camera’s en computer-visionmodellen die draaien op Databricks helpen ze telers en verkooporganisaties om betere inzichten te krijgen in hun gewassen, oogstvoorspellingen te verbeteren en voedselverspilling te verminderen.
Het platform is inmiddels live en vormt de basis voor de volgende groeifase. De Azure-omgeving staat, de datamodellen draaien en er ligt volop ruimte om het platform verder uit te bouwen. Dat betekent: nieuwe features bouwen, technologie ontdekken, verbeteren wat er al staat en vooral veel leren.

Je komt terecht in een compact en betrokken team waar ideeën snel worden opgepakt en waar je niet maanden hoeft te wachten voordat je iets daadwerkelijk in productie ziet. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid voor je niveau en volop ruimte om jezelf technisch te ontwikkelen. Samen werken ze aan technologie die niet alleen interessant is, maar ook daadwerkelijk bijdraagt aan duurzamere landbouw en minder voedselverspilling.

Functie

Als Junior .NET Developer ga je vanaf dag één meebouwen aan het platform. Je werkt voornamelijk met C#, .NET Core, API’s en SQL, maar krijgt daarnaast de mogelijkheid om je te ontwikkelen in Azure, data en vooral AI.
AI is binnen deze organisatie geen buzzword voor op de roadmap. Ze zijn actief aan het ontdekken hoe AI Agents en Agentic AI kunnen worden ingezet om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en innovatiever te maken. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan AI die developers ondersteunt bij het schrijven, testen en verbeteren van code, maar ook aan nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen het platform zelf.
Je hoeft absoluut nog geen AI-expert te zijn. Nieuwsgierigheid is belangrijker dan ervaring. Vind je het interessant om met ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude of andere AI-developmenttools te experimenteren? Heb je tijdens je studie, stage of in een eigen project al eens met AI of LLM’s gewerkt? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen.
Je werkt samen met ervaren developers en de CTO. Hierdoor leer je niet alleen hoe je goede code schrijft, maar ook hoe je nadenkt over architectuur, schaalbaarheid, cloud en data. Je krijgt de vrijheid om nieuwe technieken uit te proberen en wordt aangemoedigd om met ideeën te komen.
Omdat het team relatief compact is, zie je bovendien direct wat er met jouw werk gebeurt. Geen eindeloze lagen tussen idee en uitvoering, maar bouwen, testen, leren en verbeteren.

Eisen

Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar
Basiservaring met C# en/of .NET vanuit studie, stage, werk of eigen projecten
Basiskennis van SQL
Interesse in Azure en cloudtechnologie
Je wordt enthousiast van AI en nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI Agents / Agentic AI en moderne AI-development tooling
Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe technologie zelf uit te proberen
Je bent leergierig, zelfstandig en niet bang om vragen te stellen
Je neemt graag initiatief en denkt mee over hoe dingen slimmer kunnen
Je voelt je prettig in een startup / scale-up omgeving

Pré:

Ervaring met Azure
Ervaring met API development
Ervaring met Databricks of data-intensieve systemen
Je hebt al eens gewerkt met LLM’s, AI Agents, GitHub Copilot of andere AI-developmenttools
Je bent gevestigd in de regio Eindhoven vanwege samenwerking en afstemming op locatie
Engels is belangrijk in deze rol; Nederlands is een plus, maar geen harde eis

Aanbod

Een salaris tot ca. €3.800,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van ervaring
40 uur per week
25 vakantiedagen
8% vakantiegeld
Pensioenregeling

Activiteiten buiten werktijd zoals bbq’s, sportdag, rooftop concert, lunchen, feestjes en meer!
Veel ruimte om jezelf technisch én inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen
Werken met moderne technologie rondom .NET, Azure, data en AI
De mogelijkheid om actief mee te bouwen aan de AI-developmentvisie van de organisatie

jobs.title: (Junior) C# Developer
jobs.description:
Are you interested in being part of a company that shapes the future of space and cyber technologies?

Join our software development team in Leiden, the Netherlands, as a C# Developer.
Working with C#, WPF, Blazor and PostgreSQL, you will help deliver innovative engineering and business applications, with an initial focus on data-driven solutions for the Dutch Ministry of Defence. This position is well suited to both recent graduates with relevant practical experience and software engineers with a few years of professional experience.

About Us

Starion provides engineering, consultancy and technology solutions for space, defence and critical infrastructure organisations across Europe. With over 30 years of expertise, we combine space engineering, digital technologies and innovation to deliver solutions that support world-leading missions and tackle some of society’s most important challenges.

Tasks and activities

Designing, developing and maintaining complex data-driven applications that support critical business and engineering activities.
Building and enhancing design-critical software solutions used during the early phases of engineering and system development.
Performing verification and validation activities to ensure software quality, reliability and performance.
Optimising high-throughput collaborative systems, enhancing scalability, efficiency and user experience.
Designing and developing supporting tools, frameworks and libraries that enable efficient software delivery and long-term maintainability.

Skills and experience

A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
A solid background in both frontend and background application development.
Proficiency in working with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

The following skills and experience would be highly desirable:
Familiarity with Git, GitHub and/or GitLab.
Hands-on knowledge with WPF, Blazor, MVVM.
Knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and software quality practices.
Experience working on large-scale software projects.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices.
Experience with data modelling (e.g. UML, Ecore).
Familiarity with Linux, Docker, and web/mobile development using TypeScript or JavaScript.

Why should you apply?

You will have the opportunity to work within leading space organisations across Europe.
We encourage everyone to think outside the box and to push the boundaries of traditional knowledge. This role is an opportunity to join a forward-thinking company and allows for a deeper understanding of the industry.
To be part of a company that values integrity, inspiration, care and collaboration.
Benefits include: competitive remuneration packages; unique career opportunities, including working in other countries; access to training and development programmes; flexible relocation support.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager – SaaS | Utrecht (Hybrid) | 120k

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager for a growing SaaS organization in Utrecht. The company develops an innovative SaaS platform for the real estate sector, enabling real estate professionals to digitally manage and optimize their processes. The scalable product is used daily by more than 350 customers (In private & public sectors) in the real estate industry.

The international engineering team currently consists of 11 professionals and is entering an important next phase: transitioning from one team into two, and potentially three autonomous, cross-functional teams. You will work closely with the tech lead, who owns the technical direction, while you focusing on building high-performing teams!

We are looking for someone who has successfully guided this type of change before, someone who understands the challenges, has seen what can fail, and knows how to build high performing teams. As Engineering Manager, you will help shape the future engineering organization by creating more ownership, improving delivery and enabling teams to work more autonomously.

You will focus on:

Coaching and developing a team of 4-6 engineers.
Improving delivery processes and collaboration with Product.
Establishing clear ownership and effective ways of working.
Supporting organizational change and continuous improvement.

Who we are looking for

8+ years of experience in software engineering.
3+ years of experience managing engineering teams.

jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Innovation Engineer | Utrecht | €90K (Hybrid/SaaS).

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer with a strong interest in AI to help shape the future of a proven SaaS platform in the real estate sector. The company develops an innovative SaaS solution used daily by hundreds of customers in the private and public sector. The product is well established, but AI is opening up new possibilities for automation and how users interact with the platform.

The role:

Your challenge will be to figure out what we can actually do with AI and turn those ideas into working solutions. You will build and experiment with AI agents that can understand what a user wants, work with the existing backend and databases, and take action on their behalf.

A key part of this will be permissions and customer environments. An agent needs to understand not only what is technically possible, but also what a specific user is allowed to do. Think about replacing manual workflows with an AI agent that can understand a request and execute the right steps. The goal is to find opportunities where AI can simply take work off people's hands.

This is a new area for the company, so you will have plenty of room to experiment. We are looking for someone who is willing to push boundaries, test ideas and ask: why are we still doing this manually if AI can do it?

Requirements:

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience, a solid understanding of backend development and databases, and a genuine interest in AI. You don't need years of AI experience. What matters is that you understand how software works and are excited to explore how agents can be built and integrated into a real product.

You will work closely with the engineering team to experiment, build prototypes and turn successful ideas into reliable features. Most importantly, you are curious, pragmatic and not afraid to try something new.

Benefits:

€90k
Bonus
Pension
Hybrid working
Initial 12-month contract, after that permanent.

jobs.title: Software-Architect .NET (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Architectural Leadership: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Klassische & moderne Welten: Du bewegst dich sicher sowohl in klassischen Enterprise-Architekturen (z. B. Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme, On-Prem) als auch in modernen cloud-nativen Szenarien (Microservices, Container, Event-Driven).
Tech Strategy & Guidance: Du definierst Architektur- und Technologie-Standards (Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design, Domain-Driven Design) und unterstützt Teams bei der Umsetzung.
Consulting & Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Architektur bis zur produktiven Einführung.
Innovation Driver: Du bringst Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps aktiv in die Projekte ein.

DEIN PROFIL

Background: Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Architektur-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Software-Architekturen, sowohl im klassischen On-Prem-Umfeld als auch in der Cloud.
Engineering Skills: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit .NET Core, C#, Cloud-Services (Azure/AWS/GCP), Container-Orchestrierung (Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform, Bicep) sowie Erfahrung mit der Modernisierung bestehender Systeme zu Microservices, Cloud & SaaS.
Strategie & Delivery: Know-how in Anforderungsanalyse, Betriebskonzepten, Security-Architekturen und in der Transformation von Legacy-Systemen zu skalierbaren Plattformen.
Kommunikation & Leadership: Du bist sicher in der Moderation von Architektur-Workshops, agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Tech und coachst Entwicklerteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

The Weissenberg Group GmbH is a leading technology company dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that drive digital transformation across various industries. With a focus on cutting-edge AI integration and scalable backend systems, we strive to deliver high-quality, reliable, and future-proof technology to our clients. Our company culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence, fostering an environment where talented professionals can thrive and make a meaningful impact in the tech landscape.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Backend Developer with a passion for shaping the technological direction of AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will go beyond routine ticket handling and actively influence the architecture and design of scalable backend systems. You will leverage your extensive experience in backend development to create innovative solutions, making critical decisions regarding software architecture, APIs, data models, and system integrations. A key aspect of this position involves utilizing modern AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar agents to enhance productivity and code quality. You will be responsible for developing modern AI-supported applications, integrating external systems, and working closely with product managers, domain experts, and fellow developers to turn technological possibilities into practical, deployable solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to embed AI coding tools into daily development workflows, enabling faster, more efficient, and secure software delivery while maintaining high standards of code quality and security.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess between 7 to 10 years of professional experience in backend development, with a solid understanding of software architecture, API design, database management, and automated testing. You should have proven expertise in at least one established backend technology such as Python, Java, C#, TypeScript, or Node.js. A thorough understanding of version control systems like Git, as well as CI/CD workflows, is essential. Additionally, you should have demonstrable experience working with AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot, including prompt engineering, context management, and quality assurance of AI-generated code. Strong ownership mentality, excellent collaboration skills, and the ability to transfer knowledge effectively are crucial. Proficiency in German is required, alongside good English language skills, to facilitate seamless communication within our diverse team.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing complex backend solutions from initial concept through to production deployment. You will take ownership of software architecture, define API specifications, data models, and ensure seamless system integrations. A significant part of your role involves employing AI coding tools productively for tasks such as implementation, refactoring, testing, and troubleshooting. You will critically evaluate AI-generated code for quality, security, and maintainability, ensuring that standards are consistently met. Collaborating closely with product teams, domain experts, and fellow developers, you will help develop AI-enabled applications and services, integrating large language model (LLM) APIs and external systems. You will also contribute to establishing and maintaining development standards, best practices, and technological innovations within the team. Your expertise will help shape the future of AI-driven backend development, making a tangible impact on projects and organizational growth.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, growth, and well-being. You will have access to a €600 health budget for massages, glasses, and other health-related expenses, along with top-tier health insurance coverage for you and your family. To promote a healthy and active lifestyle, we provide fitness bonuses, quick access to medical specialists, and a digital health coach. Our flexible working arrangements include options for remote work and 30 days of vacation, ensuring a healthy work-life balance. We guarantee job security through permanent employment contracts and foster professional growth with ongoing training and development opportunities. Enjoy a relaxed and engaging work environment with team events, modern green office spaces, and additional perks such as discounts, parking facilities, fresh fruit, and beverages. Take advantage of online shopping discounts, company car options for professional and private use, environmentally friendly mobility solutions like JobRad leasing, and access to fitness and health services through EGYM Wellpass. We also offer programs like JobCar, sustainable E-Car leasing, and affordable hardware leasing via MeinMPP to support your personal and professional needs.

Equal Opportunity

Weissenberg Group GmbH is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds foster innovation and drive excellence. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. Our hiring process is fair and transparent, and we strive to provide equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees. Join us and become part of a forward-thinking organization that values diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our work culture.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager C#/.NET (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Technische Führung, starke Teams und verlässliche Produktentwicklung

Unser Mandant entwickelt geschäftskritische Softwarelösungen für den digitalen Handel. Die Anwendungen unterstützen mehr als 50.000 Unternehmen bei der Steuerung ihrer Warenwirtschaft sowie bei der Anbindung von Onlineshops und digitalen Marktplätzen.
Für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Softwareentwicklungsteams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die technisches Verständnis, moderne Mitarbeiterführung und einen ausgeprägten Blick für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung verbindet.
Als Engineering Manager schaffen Sie die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass aus Produktideen zuverlässige Softwarelösungen entstehen. Sie geben Ihrem Team Orientierung, fördern eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und sorgen gemeinsam mit Product Management, Tech Leads und Architektur für klare Prioritäten und realistische Ziele.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie übernehmen die disziplinarische Führung eines Entwicklungsteams und begleiten Ihre Mitarbeitenden durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Coaching und individuelle Entwicklungsmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus wirken Sie an der Gewinnung und erfolgreichen Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder mit.
Gemeinsam mit dem Product Management übersetzen Sie Produktziele in umsetzbare Vorhaben und sorgen für klare Anforderungen, sinnvolle Prioritäten und eine realistische Planung.
Sie tragen Verantwortung für die verlässliche Umsetzung vereinbarter Ziele. Dabei schaffen Sie Transparenz über Fortschritte, erkennen Risiken oder Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und unterstützen das Team bei deren Lösung.
Sie gestalten die operativen Entwicklungsabläufe - von Refinements und Sprintplanungen bis zur laufenden Steuerung von Kapazitäten, Qualität und technischen Themen.
Aufgrund Ihrer eigenen Entwicklungserfahrung können Sie technische Zusammenhänge fundiert beurteilen, Lösungsansätze kritisch begleiten und sich mit Entwicklern, Tech Leads und Architekten auf Augenhöhe austauschen.
Sie fördern den Wissensaustausch und eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Teams sowie über Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg.
KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge setzen Sie reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag ein und unterstützen Ihr Team dabei, neue Möglichkeiten sinnvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery zu integrieren.

Ihr Profil

Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination eines Softwareentwicklungsteams, beispielsweise als Engineering Manager, Development Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
Sie bringen mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in C# und dem .NET-Umfeld mit.
Sie verbinden einen wertschätzenden Führungsstil mit der Fähigkeit, klare Erwartungen zu formulieren, Entscheidungen zu treffen und auch anspruchsvolle Themen konstruktiv anzusprechen.
Sie verstehen moderne Softwareentwicklungsprozesse und haben bereits Verantwortung für Planungen, Releases oder die zuverlässige Umsetzung technischer Vorhaben übernommen.
Auch in komplexen oder über längere Zeit gewachsenen Systemlandschaften behalten Sie den Überblick und können technische sowie organisatorische Zusammenhänge einordnen.
Sie interessieren sich für die Prozesse hinter dem Produkt und möchten verstehen, wie die entwickelte Software im Arbeitsalltag der Kunden eingesetzt wird.
Im Umgang mit Veränderungen, konkurrierenden Anforderungen und begrenzten Ressourcen handeln Sie strukturiert und pragmatisch.
Sie sind offen für KI-basierte Entwicklungswerkzeuge und moderne Engineering-Ansätze.
Für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld verfügen Sie über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbungsbearbeitung

Vielen Dank für Ihr Interesse an der ausgeschriebenen Position.
Falls Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Eingang Ihrer Bewerbung keine Rückmeldung von uns erhalten, bedeutet dies leider, dass wir Ihre Bewerbung für den aktuellen Auswahlprozess nicht weiterverfolgen konnten. Dies stellt jedoch keine Bewertung Ihrer Qualifikationen dar, sondern ist auf das hohe Bewerbungsaufkommen zurückzuführen.

Engineering Manager, Tech Lead , Softwareentwicklung, AI, C#, .NET, Teamlead, Lead Engineer

Senior .NET Engineer | FinTech | C#, .NET, Azure, SQL | London | Hybrid 3-4 days | Up to £95K

jobs.title: Software Engineer - BrandX
jobs.description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order Engineering ’ group.

BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard.

The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work.

How you’ll make an impact

Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with.
Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them.
Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer.
Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change.
Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do.
Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way.
Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback.
Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes.
Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems.

What will set you up for success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects.
Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write.
Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point.
Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems.
You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place.
AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further.
You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.

jobs.description:
Willis Re is building its global technology estate from the ground up, unencumbered by legacy and designed around data, analytics and modern cloud platforms. We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the products that power our reinsurance broking, analytics and client-facing platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across the whole stack and is equally comfortable building conventional services and AI-enabled features. You will work alongside architects, product stakeholders and delivery partners to ship software that brokers and analysts use every day.

Key Responsibilities

Build Across the Stack: Design, build and ship features end to end, from APIs and services through to responsive, accessible user interfaces.
Cloud Native Delivery: Develop and run cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, using PaaS services, containers and infrastructure-as-code.
Data-Driven Features: Consume data through APIs and services to surface it in usable, performant ways for brokers and analysts.
AI-Enabled Development: Build AI-enabled product features using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and API integration, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Claude Cowork as part of your day-to-day workflow, and help the wider team adopt them well.
Integration: Integrate with external market platforms, carrier and client systems, and vendor SaaS products using API-first and event-driven patterns.
Quality & Security: Practise test-driven development and write secure, maintainable code, applying established security patterns including authentication and authorisation (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0), data protection and privacy from the start.
Collaboration: Build to the agreed architectural standards and help shape them, contributing to design discussions, reviewing code from in-house and partner engineers, and mentoring others across a greenfield estate.

About You

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys a fast-moving, greenfield environment and wants to work across both traditional and AI-native development. Ideally you will bring:

Experience: Extensive experience of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production systems end to end. Experience in insurance, reinsurance or wider financial services is a plus, but not essential.
Backend: Strong programming skills in C#/.NET or Python, with solid API design and strong SQL.
Frontend: Practical experience building modern user interfaces with React or Angular and TypeScript.
Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Standards & Security: Experience building to architectural standards and applying common patterns such as microservices, event-driven and API-led design, together with a strong grounding in security patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Entra ID, RBAC) and secure coding practices.
Data: Comfortable working with relational databases and data-heavy application features, with strong SQL and an eye for query performance.
AI Development: Experience building with LLMs and AI-enabled solutions, or a clear appetite to learn. Familiarity with agentic patterns, prompt design and evaluation is a significant advantage.
Engineering Craft: Fluency in test-driven development and automated testing, an eye for maintainable design, and good judgement about when to keep things simple.
Communication: Ability to work closely with product stakeholders and delivery partners, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly.

About Willis Re

We combine specialist broking with analytics, modeling and research to help insurers optimize risk transfer, strengthen balance sheets and achieve sustainable growth. Our approach is relationship-driven, transparent and outcome-focused.

At the heart of Willis Re is a focus on delivering the most cutting-edge analytical solutions to enable more informed, better decision-making for risk selection, portfolio optimization, and capital management.

The launch of Willis Re brings a strategic advantage of being unhindered by legacy, an ability to leverage data, statistical models and advanced technologies with the best knowledge and expertise to deliver more efficient and effective reinsurance outcomes. This places Willis Re in a unique position to build a truly analytically driven business, focused on creating solutions for the reinsurance industry that are future led and forward thinking.

Willis Re will also leverage recognized technical expertise from WTW’s Insurance Consulting & Technology business including their advanced modeling and analytical capabilities. Alongside this will be WTW’s Research Network, an award-winning business supporting and influencing science to improve the understanding and quantification of risk.

Willis Re is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive, and flexible work environment. We provide equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability, orientation, or any other legally protected categories. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please email us at talentacquisition@willisre.com

jobs.title: Senior Firmware & Software Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA Instruments™ is our instrumentation division, which designs advanced metrology and inspection instruments used in both R&D and production across industries and academia. Our tools—ranging from optical profilers and nano-indenters to thin film and defect inspection systems—enable precise surface and material analysis. We partner closely with customers to enable R&D, improve yield, optimize processes, and reduce production costs through innovative hardware, software and application expertise.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

As a Senior Firmware & Software Engineer on this team, you will design, develop, release, and support the embedded firmware and Windows desktop software that power our families of surface profiler, thin film, sheet resistance and nanoindentation measurement instruments. Working at the intersection of software, firmware, and electronics, you will build everything from low-level, real-time firmware running on instrument hardware to rich C#/.NET desktop applications, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and the latest advancements in software engineering and AI/ML/DL.

Responsibilities:

Deliver well-defined features/components with high-level guidance: estimate work, communicate risks/tradeoffs, and deliver on schedule
Collaborate cross-functionally across the development lifecycle to define architecture and create system- and subsystem-level requirements/specifications
Design, implement, and debug embedded firmware (C/C++) for microcontrollers and real-time control of instrument hardware, including communication interfaces such as USB, Ethernet, serial/UART, SPI, and I2C
Develop Windows desktop software in C#/.NET (WPF/WinForms) and C++ for instrument control, GUI, and data analysis; write maintainable, multithreaded code and use AI-assisted tools responsibly under company security policies
Partner closely with electrical and hardware engineers on board bring-up, signal and schematic debugging, and firmware/hardware co-development using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and in-circuit debuggers
Build robust unit/integration tests and use profiling to improve performance, memory usage, reliability, and security
Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and subject matter experts
Troubleshoot system/subsystem issues using logs and experiments; contribute to root-cause analysis, implement fixes with guidance, and help prevent recurrence
Demonstrate motivation to independently learn and apply new software technologies

Travel - Occasional travel may be required to KLA headquarters, customer sites, or other business locations. Travel is expected to be less than 10% of working time.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree (required) + significant relevant experience; Master’s or advanced degree (desired) + relevant experience in Electrical, Computer, Software, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, or Physics. A software engineer with a strong electrical engineering or hardware background is ideal.
A solid understanding and demonstrated track record in the practice of software engineering fundamentals, including architecture, data structures, design patterns, event-driven design, multithreaded and real-time design, testing, and debugging.
Experience with:
Microsoft .NET and C# for Windows desktop application development (WPF and/or WinForms)
C and C++ programming, including embedded firmware development
Embedded systems and microcontroller firmware, including real-time control and hardware communication protocols (USB, serial/UART, SPI, I2C)
Interfacing software and firmware with electronic hardware, and using lab instruments such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers for debugging
Microsoft Visual Studio development environment
Source code control systems such as Git
Adherence to software design and coding standards

Working knowledge of electronics with the ability to read schematics and component datasheets and collaborate effectively with electrical and hardware engineering teams
Ability to communicate effectively with peers, interdisciplinary engineering groups, customers, and suppliers, including delivering clear technical presentations
Adept at collaborating with teams across the US, Europe, and Asia
Self-driven individual with strong technical ability, a systematic approach, and excellent problem-solving skills

Preferred:

Experience contributing to architecture and design for complex subsystems and influencing technical decisions through strong design and code reviews
Experience improving performance and diagnostics/observability for system-level software
Experience with RTOS, bare-metal firmware, device drivers, and low-level debugging
Familiarity with digital and analog electronics, sensors, motion control, and signal processing
Experience collaborating across teams on system integration and software releases for complex systems
Experience delivering AI/ML capabilities in products
UX skills including wireframing, prototyping, and user flow design

Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role

What we will offer you?

KLA’s benefits package includes:

Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, share scheme, rewards scheme and life assurance

Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.
Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base, and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology, and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.
As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a Solutions Architect to define enterprise-grade application solution architecture for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives within a Banking & Capital Markets environment.

About the Role

You will be responsible for assessing complex existing application and integration landscapes, particularly Microsoft technology-based estates, identifying modernization opportunities, and designing scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable and cloud-agnostic target solutions aligned to business capabilities and enterprise architecture standards.
You will bring strong functional understanding and technical depth to translate business workflows, operating processes, integration dependencies, data flows, control points, reporting requirements and non-functional needs into practical modernization blueprints. The role involves defining migration-ready architecture patterns across .NET, C#, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure and related Microsoft-based technologies, evaluating technology options, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring solutions address scalability, availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO, security, auditability, observability, operational resilience and long-term supportability.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Solution Architecture
Application Legacy Modernization
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Microservices
Kafka / Event-Driven Architecture
Kubernetes
API & Integration Modernization
HA/DR design
DevSecOps / GitOps

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Capital Markets domain experience
DORA / operational resilience awareness

Key Competencies:

Strong enterprise solution architecture experience in large-scale legacy modernization, application transformation, distributed systems, financial services platforms or high-volume transaction processing environments.
Ability to assess legacy estates including monolithic applications, tightly coupled integrations, shared databases, batch workflows, reporting platforms, operational bottlenecks and technology obsolescence risks.
Ability to understand business capabilities, functional workflows, operating models, reporting needs, controls, data dependencies and user journeys, and translate them into executable modernization solutions.
Deep understanding of microservices, domain-driven design, API design, database-per-service, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging and enterprise integration design patterns.
Hands-on knowledge of Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms, IBM MQ, REST, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, message transformation, replayability, retry, exception handling and reconciliation patterns.
Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, cloud-native deployment, CI/CD, GitOps, Terraform, secrets management and DevSecOps engineering practices.
Good working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP cloud services, cloud landing zones, networking, identity, security, observability, resilience and workload deployment patterns.
Hands-on exposure to Azure architecture and Microsoft-based modernization patterns, including App Services, AKS, Azure SQL or SQL Server modernization, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and secure enterprise deployment practices.
Knowledge of cloud-agnostic architecture principles, multi-cloud deployment considerations, workload portability, exit strategy, high availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO definition and cross-environment resilience patterns.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platform concepts such as batch and streaming data flows, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance and regulatory data controls will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of Microsoft application landscapes including .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, stored procedures, SSIS/SSRS awareness, Azure services, PostgreSQL, Redis, relational modelling, reporting platforms and approaches for modernizing legacy enterprise applications.
Experience defining migration approaches such as strangler pattern, phased cutover, parallel run, dual operation, output reconciliation, rollback design, hyper-care and legacy decommissioning.
Ability to evaluate trade-offs across business value, functional fit, technology choices, portability, performance, resilience, security, operational complexity, cost and regulatory or audit expectations.
Experience defining non-functional requirements, performance baselines, availability models, disaster recovery approaches, observability KPIs, operational runbooks and support models.
Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, product owners, operations users, engineering teams, senior stakeholders and client technology teams.
Financial services, capital markets, trade lifecycle, risk, regulatory reporting, data warehouse modernization or operational resilience exposure will be an advantage.

Certifications (Preferred):

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner

What You Will Do

Lead enterprise solution architecture for legacy modernization initiatives covering business capabilities, application architecture, integration, data, cloud, security, DevSecOps, observability and operational supportability.
Assess existing application portfolios, monolithic platforms, shared databases, batch processing flows, integration dependencies, reporting workloads and operational constraints to define modernization priorities and solution options.
Understand business processes, user journeys, data flows, upstream/downstream dependencies, reporting needs, control requirements and operational pain points to shape fit-for-purpose enterprise solution designs.
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into modernization roadmaps, architecture decisions, solution blueprints, integration patterns, service boundaries, data models, deployment views and implementation guidance.
Architect enterprise-grade application solutions using microservices, domain-aligned service design, API-first integration, event-driven workflows, service-owned databases and containerized runtime models.
Design enterprise integration solutions using Kafka, IBM MQ, REST APIs, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, canonical events, adapters, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling and reconciliation patterns.
Architect cloud-native and platform-agnostic solutions using Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, AKS/GKE or equivalent platforms, with appropriate runtime, networking, secrets, identity, deployment and portability considerations.
Provide Azure-focused architecture guidance including Azure landing zones, compute, networking, identity, security, monitoring, deployment, integration and migration patterns for enterprise application modernization.
Provide architecture guidance for application-facing data needs including data access patterns, reporting integrations, data contracts, auditability, lineage awareness and alignment with enterprise data platforms.
Define and review technical designs involving .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, middleware, reporting platforms, stored procedures and modernization of legacy Microsoft-based enterprise applications.
Assess and document non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, latency, availability, resilience, disaster recovery, failover, security, auditability, monitoring and operational support.
Define high availability and disaster recovery architecture including active-active or active-passive patterns, failover design, backup and restore strategy, cross-region or cross-cloud resilience, RPO/RTO targets and business continuity considerations.
Support phased modernization planning including strangler pattern, coexistence with legacy systems, parallel run, data reconciliation, cutover readiness, rollback planning, risk mitigation and legacy decommissioning considerations.
Facilitate solution discussions with business, product, operations, risk, compliance, data, infrastructure, security, DevOps, QA and client technology stakeholders to align scope, priorities, dependencies and delivery outcomes.
Create architecture artifacts such as current-state assessments, high-level designs, target-state blueprints, interface specifications, sequence flows, deployment views, data flow diagrams, technology decision records and architecture summaries.
Work with engineering teams to ensure solution designs are implementable, testable, observable, secure, migration-ready and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

Why Join Us

At Acuity Analytics, you'll have the opportunity to work across complex enterprise Azure environments while helping shape and improve our Managed Services capability.
You'll solve challenging technical problems, influence standards and automation, mentor other engineers, and work closely with customers and technical teams.
People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.

Principal Software Engineer -
We’re working with a leading UK technology business that is embarking on a major AI-driven engineering transformation. The business is challenging the traditional approach to software delivery and asking a fundamental question: can a world-class engineer working alongside AI agents deliver the output, speed and quality of a much larger engineering team?

They are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join an initial 8 week production pilot to assess what agentic engineering can achieve in a real-world environment.
This is not an AI research role. It is an opportunity for an exceptional software engineer who has already embraced AI tooling in their workflow, understands how to use agents effectively, and can demonstrate how this changes the way complex engineering problems are solved.

The Role

You’ll work alongside an existing Tech Lead to drive the modernisation of a core customer-facing application. The ambition is to completely rebuild the platform onto a modern multi-platform architecture, while avoiding the traditional approach of a long, high-risk rewrite. The approach is incremental: establish the foundations, deliver customer value early, and progressively replace the existing application.

You’ll bring the engineering judgment, architectural thinking and AI fluency needed to understand where agents can accelerate delivery, where human expertise is essential, and how to create a new model for software development.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead an AI-native approach to rebuilding a major customer application.
Define the target architecture and technical direction.
Build production-quality software using AI agents and modern workflows.
Identify where agentic tooling can materially improve delivery speed.
Help embed new engineering practices across the team.

What They’re Looking For

Principal or Lead-level software engineering experience.
Strong architecture and modern software engineering fundamentals.
Proven experience using AI agents/tooling to accelerate complex engineering work.
Experience leading technical change, migrations or platform transformations.
Ability to operate in ambiguity and create direction.
Strong product mindset and focus on customer outcomes.

You don’t need to claim to have “mastered” agentic engineering. The field is evolving rapidly. What matters is that you have the engineering depth to understand complex systems, the curiosity to experiment, and real examples of how AI tooling has changed your approach to building software.

Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to help define what the next generation of software engineering looks like. You’ll be given significant autonomy, working on a highly visible transformation where success is measured by tangible outcomes: faster delivery, lower engineering effort, maintained quality and a new operating model for building software with AI.

For an engineer who believes AI will fundamentally change how software is created, this is an opportunity to prove it at production scale.

About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.

Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base, and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology, and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an Enterprise Architect
to help shape the future of our engineering organisation and drive technical excellence across our modernization practice.

About the Role

This role is responsible for architecture assessment, target-state definition, and modernization alignment for complex enterprise application landscapes undergoing legacy transformation. You will focus on shaping scalable, resilient, secure, and governable architectures that progressively move monolithic, tightly coupled, batch-oriented systems toward modular, event-driven, cloud-enabled and operationally observable platforms.

The role requires strong hands-on architecture depth across application modernization, integration architecture, microservices, APIs, event streaming, container platforms, database modernization, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and governance. You will collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, security, DevOps, operations, and delivery teams to define transition roadmaps, manage architectural risks, establish guardrails, validate implementation choices, and ensure modernization is delivered through controlled, incremental, and enterprise-grade transformation practices.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Architecture
Legacy Modernization
Application Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Event-Driven Architecture
API & Integration Architecture
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Domain-Driven Design
Strangler Pattern Migration
DevSecOps
CI/CD & IaC
Observability
DataBricks
Data Governance & Lineage
Cloud Portability
Kubernetes
Kafka
.NET
MSSQL / PostgreSQL

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Banking Domain experience

Key Competencies:

Proven enterprise architecture experience across large-scale legacy modernization, distributed systems, integration platforms, database ecosystems, cloud-enabled platforms, and regulated enterprise environments.
Strong ability to assess monolithic, tightly coupled, database-centric and batch-driven estates and translate findings into practical target-state architecture and migration roadmaps.
Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, service decomposition, database-per-service patterns, distributed workflows, sagas, APIs, and contract-first design.
Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, Kafka-based event streaming, schema management, asynchronous processing, replayability, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and integration resilience patterns.
Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft .NET ecosystems, REST / gRPC APIs, middleware platforms, enterprise messaging, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and application modernization technologies.
Strong understanding of cloud-agnostic and hybrid architecture principles including Kubernetes, Docker, containerized deployment, cloud portability, platform engineering, and workload isolation.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated quality gates, release orchestration, environment promotion, vulnerability scanning, and audit-ready change management.
Ability to define resilience and operational readiness requirements including high availability, disaster recovery, failover, observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, SLOs, incident handling, and support transition.
Good appreciation of enterprise data platforms like Databricks , governed reporting, data lineage, data quality, auditability, regulatory evidence, and interaction between operational systems and analytical data platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, decision facilitation, risk articulation, technical communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Ability to balance target-state architecture ambition with delivery pragmatism, coexistence constraints, incremental migration, business continuity, operational stability, and regulatory expectations.
Strong documentation discipline across architecture blueprints, transition states, decision records, integration contracts, dependency maps, runbooks, governance artifacts, and executive-level architecture narratives.

Certifications (Preferred):

TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner / TOGAF® 9 Certified
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

What You Will Do

Own enterprise architecture assessment and target-state definition for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives across application, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and operations domains.
Assess current-state monolithic applications, shared database dependencies, batch processing models, middleware integrations, reporting dependencies, operational constraints, and resiliency gaps to define pragmatic modernization pathways.
Define future-state architecture aligned to separation of concerns, microservices, database-per-service, API-led integration, event-driven processing, cloud portability, automated delivery, observability, and enterprise governance principles.
Establish architecture guardrails, reference patterns, decision records, integration standards, data ownership principles, service boundary guidance, and non-functional requirements for scalable and resilient modernization delivery.
Guide decomposition of tightly coupled legacy capabilities into domain-aligned services, reusable platform components, controlled interfaces, independently deployable modules, and governed operational workflows.
Support migration strategy using incremental modernization patterns such as strangler migration, parallel run, coexistence, controlled cutover, rollback planning, reconciliation, and phased capability transition.
Provide architecture direction for integration modernization across messaging, APIs, file-based interfaces, event streaming, schema governance, idempotent processing, error handling, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter handling.
Partner with data architecture teams to align application modernization with governed data platforms, lineage, auditability, data quality, reporting readiness, and operational data consumption patterns.
Drive architecture alignment across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment models including Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secrets management, and environment readiness.
Define and validate resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, failover, monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, operational readiness, and supportability requirements for business-critical enterprise platforms.
Facilitate architecture governance forums, technical design reviews, solution walkthroughs, migration readiness assessments, risk reviews, and cross-team decision-making across delivery workstreams.
Support implementation oversight during build, test, deployment, cutover, stabilization, and hyper-care phases to ensure solutions remain aligned with enterprise architecture guardrails and modernization objectives.
Create and maintain architecture documentation including current-state assessments, target-state blueprints, transition architectures, integration views, dependency maps, decision logs, operational runbooks, and modernization roadmaps.

Why Join Us

At Acuity Analytics, you'll have the opportunity to work across complex enterprise Azure environments while helping shape and improve our Managed Services capability.

You'll solve challenging technical problems, influence standards and automation, mentor other engineers, and work closely with customers and technical teams.

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.
