jobs.title: Software Standards Manager
jobs.description:
Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) is a leading distributor of passenger and commercial vehicle parts to the independent automotive aftermarket in Europe. It operates in France, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Hungary and Romania. The company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Genuine Parts Company (GPC), the largest global automotive replacement parts distributor with activities in North America, Europe, and Australasia. AAG’s network serves thousands of customers across Europe supported by a logistics infrastructure of 75 Distribution Centres, approximately 2,550 Stores and thousands of vehicle repairers, body shops and auto-centres. AAG has a revenue of 3.4 billion euros with over 17,000 employees. Learn more at www.allianceautomotivegroup.eu

The Software Standards Manager is a new role within Alliance Automotive UK & Ireland, reporting to the Head of Digital & Internal Applications. Operating across both B2B, B2C and internal technology teams, this role exists to bring structure, visibility, and control to a diverse and evolving software landscape shaped by organic and acquisition growth.

With multiple homegrown and proprietary applications primarily built on .NET and LAMP stacks, our engineering teams have historically operated with autonomy in tooling, frameworks, and processes. As we continue to scale, we must now centralise standards around source code management, vulnerability remediation, technical debt allocation, and risk reporting—without disrupting the pace of business value delivery.

The Software Standards Manager acts as the bridge between delivery-focused development teams and compliance, cyber, and risk stakeholders. This role protects engineering capacity by creating a structured intake and prioritisation model for security and compliance requests, ensuring they are logged, translated into backlog items, and progressed in a measurable way.

You will own the catalogue of internally developed applications, maintain visibility of framework lifecycle status, and oversee vulnerability posture across SAST and monitoring tools such as New Relic and Tenable. Through clear weekly reporting and monthly scorecards, you will provide leadership with a single, reliable view of remediation progress and risk exposure.

This is a highly visible and influential role, combining governance, technical literacy and stakeholder management to ensure our software estate is secure and sustainable.

Responsibilities

Technical Role Delivery

Own and maintain a centralised catalogue of all internally developed applications, including framework versions, hosting environments, ownership, and lifecycle status
Drive the centralisation and standardisation of code repository management and software governance practices
Establish and manage a structured intake process for cyber and compliance requirements
Consolidate vulnerability findings from tools such as New Relic, Tenable, and other monitoring platforms
Translate security and compliance findings into clearly defined, prioritised backlog items within Agile workflows
Participate in Agile ceremonies (stands-ups, reviews, retrospectives) to ensure visibility and progress of remediation tasks
Advocate for and track a defined allocation of development capacity toward technical debt and vulnerability remediation
Protect development teams from unstructured or reactive requests by creating a controlled and prioritised engagement model

Performance & Reporting

Act as the primary liaison between Digital, Compliance, and Cyber teams
Design and own structured reporting templates, dashboards, and scorecards
Provide weekly progress updates and monthly governance scorecards to the Head of Department(s) and wider stakeholders
Establish a single source of truth for software risk posture and remediation progress
Clearly communicate risk exposure, remediation velocity, and technical debt reduction trends
Reduce reactive reporting cycles by implementing consistent and predictable governance communications
Support leadership decision-making with accurate, transparent, and actionable insights
Deliver a long-term change program to enable Ping Identity IGA & MFA across all employee-accessed applications

Essential Requirements

Candidate Qualities & Experience

Proven experience working within software engineering environments (Agile/DevOps)
Strong understanding of SDLC, backlog management, and sprint planning processes
Practical experience with vulnerability management and SAST tooling
Ability to interpret technical risk and translate it into prioritised, actionable remediation plans
Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams without direct line management authority
Experience designing and delivering structured reporting to senior stakeholders.
Working knowledge of modern application stacks (including .NET and/or LAMP environments)
Familiarity with cloud hosting environments and application lifecycle management
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline

Highly Desirable Qualities

Experience centralising code repositories and driving engineering standards across multiple teams
Exposure to multi-entity or acquisition-led environments with fragmented technology estates
Experience engaging with Cyber Security and Compliance stakeholders
Experience building governance dashboards or automated reporting metrics
Exposure to SSO and IGA rollout projects (preferably Ping Identity)
Relevant professional certifications, such as:
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Agile/Scrum certifications
ITIL (Service Management)

Personal Attributes

Structured and disciplined thinker who brings order to complex environments
Pragmatic and commercially aware, balancing risk reduction with business value delivery
Calm and credible under pressure, able to manage competing stakeholder demand
Confident communicator who can translate technical detail into executive-level clarity
Resilient and assertive when protecting engineering capacity
Naturally collaborative, building trust across Development, Cyber, Compliance, and Leadership teams
Outcome-focused, with a bias toward measurable progress and continuous improvement

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you’ll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, You’ll

Work with a cross-functional team. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features.
Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you’ll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
Mentor. You’ll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
User-focused. You’re excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
About The Role

The University of Cambridge's Information Services is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer. You will join a multidisciplinary development team within a Division of 50 engineers building high-profile bespoke web systems and cloud-native services, and modernising existing applications.

This is a hybrid position, with amazing benefits, like a defined benefit pension and 41 days of annual leave inclusive of public holidays.

Our services are public-facing and support University staff and students (~60,000 people), meaning your work will have a significant impact on the reputation of one of the world's leading universities. We develop new services using modern web architectural standards with an emphasis on reusability, APIs, test automation, and CI. Services are deployed to cloud infrastructure in Docker containers.

Our technology stack is published in our Guidebook and comprises technologies like Google Cloud, Terraform, Docker, Python, Django, React, and TypeScript. We maintain a DevOps culture and use Scrum for our day-to-day work. We have also adopted an "open by default" approach to new work and thus you can find much of our work to date in our GitLab. The team also produces a Guidebook that collects the team's practices and useful information at https://guidebook.devops.uis.cam.ac.uk/

What we're looking for

You will be highly skilled in modern software development, testing, security, and operations, and be an expert in:

Architecting secure-by-design web applications and APIs with a focus on maintainability and stability, using clean code.

Integrating applications via APIs, event buses, and asynchronous tasks.

Writing expert-level Python and Django, with working knowledge of TypeScript and React (or comparable languages and frameworks).

Packaging web applications in Docker containers.

Writing and applying efficient tests with good knowledge of testing frameworks and testing best practices.

Conducting thorough code reviews.

Using AI coding assistants effectively, writing clear prompts, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and taking responsibility for its correctness, security, and maintainability.

Building CI/CD pipelines in GitLab to test and deploy web applications to the cloud using Terraform.

Working with Google Cloud or similar cloud platforms.

Managing software requirements, priorities, and dependencies.

Driving improvements in technical architecture, standards, and processes, and choosing the right solution for the problem (switching off, extending, building, or buying).

Debug effectively in unfamiliar applications.

Ways Of Working

Work in cross-functional teams using a DevOps approach, mentoring more junior engineers.

Communicate clearly in both written and verbal forms, and collaborate with University colleagues, users, and business representatives to gather and refine detailed requirements.

Focus on delivery while taking a continuous-improvement approach to existing services.

Learn new skills proactively and stay current with modern practices.

Apply AI tools pragmatically as they evolve, without compromising the quality, security, or ownership of the code you ship.

Work across products and teams to build consistent architectures, thinking through their impact on other services and the wider organisation.

Understand specifications and produce simple architectures from complex problems.

Drive work to completion, adjusting pace to the urgency of the task.

Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 2 years in the first instance.

Applications are welcome from internal candidates who would like to apply for the role on the basis of a secondment from their current role in the University.

We welcome applications from individuals who wish to be considered for part-time working or other flexible working arrangements.

We particularly welcome applications from women and /or candidates from a BME background for this vacancy as they are currently under-represented at this level in our department.

Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online.

If you would like more information about this role, informal enquiries can be directed by email to Abraham Martin, Head of DevOps amc203@cam.ac.uk

Please quote reference VC50478 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy.

The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society.

The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK.

The British Council builds connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and other countries through arts and culture, education, and the English language. We work in two ways - directly with individuals to transform their lives, and with governments and partners to make a bigger difference for the longer term, creating benefit for millions of people all over the world. We help young people to gain the skills, confidence, and connections they are looking for to realise their potential and to participate in strong and inclusive communities. We support them to learn English, to get a high-quality education and to gain internationally recognised qualifications. Our work in arts and culture stimulates creative expression and exchange and nurtures creative enterprise. We connect the best of the UK with the world and the best of the world with the UK.

The role sits as part of the Data Evidence and Performance (DEP) team, which is part of the Global Operations function and includes the central oversight and leadership for corporate planning, performance management, evaluation and reporting, the management of strategic risk and of investment, internal audit, shared services, marketing, digital and technology. DEP provides the central leadership and development for the British Council’s Data Analytics and Evidence Strategy working across the organisation with stakeholders to leverage our Data and Evidence assets. This includes driving better data quality through enterprise data governance, designing and delivering data technology and insight solutions, co-ordinating an organisational community of practice for Data Analytics and Evidence, development of the British Council KPIs framework, monitoring and reviewing performance to drive improvement, evaluation, and measurement of impact to help improve decision making.

Role Purpose

The Associate AI Engineer is part of the Data Science and Analytics team, helping to establish and build the British Council enterprise approach to Data Evidence and Performance. The role is responsible for developing, implementing, deploying and maintaining AI-enabled applications and services, working with data scientists, data engineers and Digital and Technology colleagues. The postholder applies good software engineering, cloud, security and responsible AI practices to deliver reliable, user-centred solutions, while continuing to build their technical capability.

Function Support and Service Improvement

Use Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning and other Azure AI services to build and integrate AI capabilities.
Build, test and evaluate AI and generative AI components, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic or vector search and agent-based patterns where appropriate.

Application Deployment And Support

Deploy AI applications and models to internal customers, ensuring effective integration, reliability, security and functionality.
Monitor and troubleshoot developed applications and services, resolving faults and supporting continuous improvement.
Apply British Council requirements for information security, data protection, accessibility and responsible AI, including appropriate testing and controls for AI-specific risks.

Agile Development

Work in an agile development environment, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
Own defined work packages, prioritise tasks with the team and deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines.

Relationship and Stakeholder Management

Support the development of customer-centric and insight-led working.
Collaborate with team members, stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand user and business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly.

Leadership and management (self-development)

Complete British Council induction, mandatory training and role-related learning.
Keep technical knowledge current across AI, software engineering and cloud technologies, applying learning to practical delivery.
Seek feedback and mentoring, contribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing, and take responsibility for continuous professional development

Minimum/essential

Degree-level qualification or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant STEM discipline.
Applied AI engineering. Practical experience, gained through employment, internship, academic work or substantial projects, of building AI or machine learning applications.
Programming and software engineering. Proficiency in Python and experience with APIs, JSON, Git/version control and testing. Familiarity with SQL and software development practices.
Generative AI and machine learning. Practical understanding of large language models and common patterns such as prompt engineering, embeddings or vector search, RAG and agentic workflows, plus familiarity with at least one machine learning or AI framework or SDK.
Cloud and deployment. Practical exposure to Azure or another major cloud platform for developing or deploying applications, with an understanding of CI/CD, containers and monitoring concepts.
Responsible delivery and collaboration. Understanding of information security, data protection and responsible AI risks, and the ability to work in an agile, multidisciplinary team and communicate technical issues clearly

Desirable

Microsoft AI stack. Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning or related Azure AI services.
AI engineering tools. Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain or LlamaIndex, and with vector databases or semantic search.
Full-stack delivery. Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, REST APIs and frontend or low-code development such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Microsoft Power Apps.

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Today, EF English Live does not consistently apply appropriate QA coverage to relevant Salesforce and Web tickets before release. Volume has outpaced our current QA capacity, so coverage gaps happen, and where testing does happen it often leans towards happy-path checks rather than risk-based regression testing. We already use AIO for automation and want to build on it further, and more hands are needed to close the coverage gap in the meantime.

This role is about adding real capacity: hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, with risk-based coverage applied according to the nature and impact of each change, plus active support extending and complementing our existing AIO automation. Our existing QA lead will continue to own and drive the automation strategy; this hire works alongside them, splitting time between hands-on testing and helping extend that automation over time.

Role Overview

This is a fixed-term contract engagement, initially for 4 to 6 months. The Senior QA Automation Engineer will provide thorough, hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based coverage according to the nature and impact of each change, while also helping extend and complement our existing AIO automation. This is a genuinely hybrid role: meaningful hands-on testing capacity now, and a growing share of automation work over time , done in close partnership with our existing QA lead rather than in place of them.

Within 3 Months, Success Looks Like

All relevant Salesforce and Web tickets receiving appropriate QA coverage before release, with risk-based testing applied according to the nature and impact of the change.
Regression testing meaningfully expanded beyond happy-path checks.
Our existing AIO automation extended and complemented, with additional tooling or approaches identified where they would provide better coverage or maintainability.
The existing QA lead measurably better supported, with more capacity across the team rather than the load resting on one person.

Main Responsibilities

Hands-On QA Coverage (Salesforce & Web)

Provide thorough manual and exploratory testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based testing according to the nature and impact of each change.
Prioritise regression testing, not just happy-path checks, to reduce the risk of shipping undetected issues.

Test Automation & Tooling

Extend and complement our existing AIO automation, identifying where additional tooling or approaches would provide better coverage or maintainability.
Work alongside the existing QA lead, who owns the overall automation strategy and roadmap, contributing hands-on automation build where needed.

Collaboration & Capability Building

Work alongside the existing QA lead and engineering team to raise the overall QA bar, across both tooling and process.
Partner with Business Systems and engineering leads to prioritise coverage based on commercial risk.

Reporting

Report to Business Systems Engineering leadership, with visibility on release risk and quality metrics shared with the wider team.

Technical Background & Skills

Core Experience

Strong hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience across web applications and, ideally, CRM/Salesforce environments.
Experience in automating tests using Javascript /Typescript frameworks (e.g. Nightwatch.js, Cypress, Playwright)
Experience with API and integration testing, including validating data flows between Salesforce, web applications and third-party systems.
Comfortable splitting time between hands-on ticket testing and automation work, rather than being purely one or the other.

Ways of Working

Genuinely hybrid: as comfortable manually testing a ticket as contributing to an automation framework.
Collaborative: complements and supports the existing QA lead's automation strategy rather than working around it.
Pragmatic about what to automate first, while making sure day-to-day coverage across Salesforce and Web doesn't slip in the meantime.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Data & AI Solutions Architect to own and evolve VantagePoint's internal data, systems and automation architecture as we continue to scale.
Our ambition is to build a best-in-class internal data and technology ecosystem - connected, scalable and increasingly AI-enabled. As a finance transformation and technology consultancy, we want the way we operate internally to reflect the same standards and ambition we bring to our clients.
This is a hands-on role. You'll set the direction and architecture, but you'll also build, configure, integrate and improve the solutions behind it. You'll inherit an active roadmap, deliver immediate improvements and help shape what our future technology and data landscape should look like.
The challenge isn't simply technical. You'll work across the business to understand requirements, prioritise competing needs, make recommendations and lead change through to adoption.
We need someone equally comfortable stepping back to design the right solution and getting stuck in to make it work.

Our tech stack

You'll be working across a broad and evolving technology landscape, including:
Microsoft 365 | NetSuite | Sage | CCH Tagetik | Attio | n8n | Zapier | SQL | Power BI | Rippling | Cledara | Notion | Rocketlane | Claude

You don't need to have worked with every platform. We're more interested in your ability to understand how systems, data and workflows fit together, learn new technologies quickly and design better ways of connecting them.

What you'll own

Data & systems architecture

Own the architecture across our core internal systems, data and integrations.
Design clean, scalable data models and flows across commercial, delivery, finance and operational platforms.
Set clear standards for data quality, governance, integrations and development.
Identify architectural weaknesses, duplication and manual processes and design pragmatic solutions.
Balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability.

Automation & AI

Identify where automation and AI can materially improve how the business operates.
Design and build automated workflows across systems and teams.
Explore and implement practical AI-enabled solutions, agents and new ways of using AI to configure and improve our systems and workflows.
Reduce manual processing, re-keying and unnecessary administration.
Help us scale the use of AI and automation across the organisation.
Measure impact through time saved, better data, reduced errors and improved decision-making.

Build & execution

Pick up our existing systems and data roadmap and move quickly into delivery.
Build and configure solutions directly, working with external developers or suppliers where needed.
Prototype ideas, test approaches and deliver quick wins alongside longer-term architecture.
Diagnose and resolve issues across systems, integrations and data flows.
Maintain appropriate technical documentation and development standards.

Roadmap & change

Own and maintain a prioritised roadmap across data, systems, automation and AI.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into clear technical plans and solutions.
Manage multiple initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption.
Communicate progress, dependencies, decisions and risks clearly.
Ensure changes work for the people using them - not just technically.

Business partnership

Build a strong understanding of how VantagePoint operates across sales, delivery, finance and operations.
Translate business problems into practical technology and data solutions.
Present recommendations and options clearly to senior stakeholders.
Bring structure to ambiguous problems and help prioritise where technology investment will create the greatest value.
Act as a trusted internal advisor while remaining close enough to the detail to deliver.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who understands the technology, sees the bigger business picture and knows how to turn both into practical solutions.

You’ll bring a strong combination of:

Data architecture, data engineering, systems architecture or software engineering experience.
Designing data models, integrations and end-to-end data flows.
Strong hands-on SQL capability and experience with relational databases.
Python or another development language used to solve real business problems.
APIs, integrations and cloud-based architectures.
Workflow automation and low-code/no-code tooling.
BI and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.
Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Practical application of AI, LLMs, agents or AI-enabled automation.
Experience working across CRM, ERP, finance, project or operational systems - experience with some of our current technology stack would be beneficial, but isn't essential.

Just as importantly, you'll be someone who:

Can think strategically without disappearing into strategy.
Enjoys being hands-on and building solutions, not just designing them.
Can take an ambiguous problem and turn it into a structured plan.
Prioritises effectively and keeps delivery moving.
Communicates confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Can challenge senior stakeholders constructively and explain your reasoning.
Understands that successful technology change is as much about people and adoption as architecture.
Takes ownership and follows things through.
Enjoys working in a fast-moving environment where not everything has already been defined.

What success looks like

Within your first 6-12 months:
We have a clear, prioritised data, systems, automation and AI roadmap.
Our core systems have cleaner, more scalable integrations and data flows.
High-value manual processes have been removed or automated.
AI and automation are embedded into how we operate, delivering measurable improvements to our systems and workflows.
Technical decisions and architecture are better documented and governed.
Teams understand what's changing, why and when.
Leadership has confidence that our internal technology landscape can support the next stage of VantagePoint's growth.

Why VantagePoint?

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of how technology, data and AI support a growing global business.
You'll join with an active roadmap and plenty to get stuck into from day one, but with genuine scope to shape what comes next. You'll work directly with senior leadership, challenge and improve how we operate, and see the impact of what you build across the business.
For someone who enjoys solving complex problems and building rather than simply maintaining, there's significant scope to make this role your own.

Quality, every time

Be human, first

The Junior Software Engineer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. To support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Warsaw to build our first non-US development center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

We kindly ask that you submit applications in English.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
1-2 years of software development experience using technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

You will join Relativity’s Data Transfer group, a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within a Scrum team, collaborating with Advanced, Senior, Lead, and Staff engineers as well as business stakeholders to develop products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne SaaS offering.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team across all phases of the service lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations
Design and architect performant, scalable, and secure software with a strong focus on quality beyond basic requirements
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles, including SOLID principles and established design patterns
Provide technical guidance to the development team to deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large datasets
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and maintainability
Develop and execute unit, integration, and static testing strategies
Apply practical knowledge of AI-assisted SDLC frameworks and best practices
Improve software development processes by recommending and driving changes
Identify and automate repetitive processes and tasks
Contribute to and enhance automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
Improve software quality and completeness while sharing knowledge across the team
Troubleshoot issues, fix defects, and respond to client-specific problems
Provide guidance and coaching to team members through knowledge sharing
Participate in on-call support rotations (second-line support) after gaining relevant experience
Support a learning culture and promote a healthy, collaborative work environment

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
At least five years of experience developing commercial-grade software using C# or related object-oriented languages such as Java or C++
Strong experience with SaaS systems, including multi-tenant architecture, subscription lifecycle, and operational support
Deep understanding of observability and telemetry, including distributed tracing, metrics, logging, alerting, and incident response
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, and debugging
Experience with cloud DevOps practices and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Harness, LaunchDarkly)
Experience working in agile teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-team collaboration
Experience with observability tools such as New Relic or Splunk
Fluency in English

Preferred

Experience working with large-scale, distributed systems and data-intensive platforms
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and frameworks
Experience improving engineering processes and automation in cloud-native environments

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

fluency in English

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Databricks)
Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

You will join Relativity’s Data Transfer group, a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within a Scrum team, collaborating with Advanced, Senior, Lead, and Staff engineers as well as business stakeholders to develop products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne SaaS offering.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team across all phases of the service lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations
Design and architect performant, scalable, and secure software with a strong focus on quality beyond basic requirements
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles, including SOLID principles and established design patterns
Provide technical guidance to the development team to deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large datasets
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and maintainability
Develop and execute unit, integration, and static testing strategies
Apply practical knowledge of AI-assisted SDLC frameworks and best practices
Improve software development processes by recommending and driving changes
Identify and automate repetitive processes and tasks
Contribute to and enhance automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
Improve software quality and completeness while sharing knowledge across the team
Troubleshoot issues, fix defects, and respond to client-specific problems
Provide guidance and coaching to team members through knowledge sharing
Participate in on-call support rotations (second-line support) after gaining relevant experience
Support a learning culture and promote a healthy, collaborative work environment

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
At least five years of experience developing commercial-grade software using C# or related object-oriented languages such as Java or C++
Strong experience with SaaS systems, including multi-tenant architecture, subscription lifecycle, and operational support
Deep understanding of observability and telemetry, including distributed tracing, metrics, logging, alerting, and incident response
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, and debugging
Experience with cloud DevOps practices and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Harness, LaunchDarkly)
Experience working in agile teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-team collaboration
Experience with observability tools such as New Relic or Splunk
Fluency in English

Preferred

Experience working with large-scale, distributed systems and data-intensive platforms
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and frameworks
Experience improving engineering processes and automation in cloud-native environments

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

Att vakna på morgonen med längtan att gå till jobbet!

Vi har ett mål att alla som jobbar hos oss ska trivas så mycket att man vaknar med ett leende på måndag morgon. Vi är kanske inte Sveriges bästa bolag inom alla punkter men vi är Sveriges näst bästa bolag enligt Great Place to Work 2020. Vi tror att det beror på vår energi och nyfikenhet, vårt sätt att välkomna olikheter och våra erfarenheter som vi gärna delar med oss av.

Rebel and Bird är ett av B3s dotterbolag som tar hand om kunders önskemål och krav och förädlar dessa till flerfaldigt prisbelönta tekniska lösningar. Du blir inte nedbunden i gamla tekniker utan får möjligheten att jobba med det senaste inom backend och utvecklas med oss varje dag. Vårt absolut tydligaste mål med verksamheten är att alla ska ha kul på jobbet. Det låter som en plattityd men det är vårt stora mål. Vi försöker (när så går) att träffas och göra roliga saker utanför arbetstid någon gång i månaden utöver julfest, sommarfest och konferenser.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer arbeta både i interna och externa åtaganden, dvs i våra egna produktutvecklingsteam där vi tar helhetsgrepp på våra kunders önskemål, från koncept till UX och publicerad webb samt ibland på konsultbasis i våra kunders team. Vi har i dagsläget tre större åtaganden men en hel del mindre inhouse-projekt och externa konsultåtaganden. Här är två större inhouse-åtaganden:

Parks and Resorts - Vi utvecklar hela webblösningen inhouse i samarbete med kundens redaktörer och produktägare för samtliga parker. Den tekniska plattformen utvecklas med contentful/gatsby och .NET/Azure. Vi har blivit uppmärksammade nationellt för detta arbete, dels med ett silver i Svenska Designpriset 2019 för Kolmården, en nominering i Svenska Designpriset 2020 för Gröna Lund (prisutdelningen har ännu inte skett så vi vet inte var vi landar) samt Kolmården seger i IDG topp-100 för bästa turismsajt.
Filmstaden - Har du bokat/köpt biobiljett? Kanske inte på sistone men innan året som gud glömde gjorde du antagligen det har du använt vår lösning. Vi ansvarar för all extern webb samt vissa interna delar. Med denna sajt vann vi IDG topp100 2018 (då SF Bio). Webben utvecklas i en episervermiljö med .NET och Azure.

Vi tror att du har:

Ca 5 års erfarenhet av att arbeta skarpt som utvecklare. Det är viktigt att du arbetat i enterprise-projekt med webb för många slutanvändare.
.NET och Azure-kompetens

Det är meriterande om du har:

Kapacitet att ta tead-roll i våra projekt.
Kompetens inom Episerver och Contentful-erfarenhet, Xamarin
Erfarenhet som konsult

Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats som kommer erbjuda distansarbete även när pandemin är över. För dem som vill jobba från kontoret på Sveavägen är det bara att komma in och jobba, dem som föredrar distansarbete kommer jobba primärt hemifrån men vara på kontoret 1-2 dagar i veckan i alla fall av primärt sociala skäl. Vi vill inte bara vara en namnlista på Slack. Utöver den naturliga komptensutvecklingen som sker av att arbeta i team med likasinnade erbjuder vi både externa och interna utbildningar. Vi startar exempelvis ett nytt initiativ vi kallar Kompetensnätverk - Från utvecklare till arkitekt, där en av våra lösningsarkitekter guidar dem som vill mot mer kunskap inom arkitektur för att förbereda dig för en roll som lösningsarkitekt om du så önskar.

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

On a daily basis you will

Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications

You will be a strong fit if you have

At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.

Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are

Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från analys och design till implementation, driftsättning och vidareutveckling. Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt

Förmåga att arbeta genom hela utvecklingskedjan från behov till förvaltning

På Avanade får du möjlighet att designa, bygga och implementera banbrytande generativ AI och agentisk AI-lösningar med hjälp av den senaste Microsoft-teknologin. Vi söker en innovativ och praktisk AI-ingenjör till vår Data & AI-verksamhet. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med kunder och multidisciplinära team för att utveckla intelligenta lösningar som löser verkliga affärsutmaningar med hjälp av Large Language Models (LLM), AI-agenter, automation och Microsoft AI-plattformar.

Den idealiska kandidaten kombinerar starka grundkunskaper inom mjukvaruutveckling och/eller data engineering med en passion för framväxande AI-teknologier och en vilja att ständigt lära, experimentera och innovera. Du kommer att bli en del av en livlig gemenskap av AI- och data-specialister, arkitekter, ingenjörer och konsulter som hjälper organisationer att förändra hur de arbetar genom generativ AI.

Om rollen

Som AI-Engineer kommer du att designa och utveckla AI-drivna applikationer, copilot och agentiska lösningar i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer att arbeta nära kunder för att förstå affärsutmaningar, identifiera möjligheter för AI-adoption och översätta krav till säkra, skalbara och produktionsklara lösningar.

Rollen kombinerar praktisk ingenjörskonst, lösningsdesign, snabb prototypframställning, kundnära konsultation och kontinuerlig innovation. Du kommer att bidra genom hela lösningens livscykel, från discovery och proof of concept till implementering, utvärdering och optimering.

Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter

Designa, utveckla och distribuera AI-drivna applikationer och agentiska lösningar med hjälp av Microsoft AI-teknologier.
Bygga intelligenta agenter, copilots och arbetsflödesautomationslösningar med hjälp av Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry och relaterade tjänster.
Utveckla API:er, integrationer och backend-tjänster med hjälp av Python och moderna applikationsramverk.
Skapa proof of concepts och prototyper för att visa framväxande AI-förmågor och affärsvärde.
Implementera prompt engineering, orkestrering, grounding och retrieval tekniker för att förbättra AI:s prestanda och tillförlitlighet.
Bygga och optimera Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-lösningar och kunskapsåtervinning-lösningar.
Bidra till AI-lösningsarkitektur, teknisk design, utveckling, testning, implementering och dokumentation.
Delta i kundworkshops, discovery-sessioner, demonstrationer och tekniska diskussioner med både affärs- och tekniska intressenter.
Tillämpa principer för ansvarsfull AI, styrningskontroller och utvärderingsramverk genom hela AI-utvecklingslivscykeln.
Samarbeta med arkitekter, ingenjörer, konsulter, analytiker och kundteam inom agila leveransmiljöer.
Håll dig uppdaterad med framväxande AI-teknologier, verktyg, ramverk och branschtrender, och dela kunskap inom den bredare verksamheten.

Qualifications

Kompetenser och Erfarenheter:

Stark erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling med skicklighet i Python.
Erfarenhet av att bygga API:er med ramverk som FastAPI, Flask eller Django.
Kunskap om containeriseringsteknologier såsom Docker.
Praktisk erfarenhet av stora språkmodeller (LLM), inklusive OpenAI GPT-modeller, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att tillämpa prompt engineering-tekniker för att förbättra modellprestanda och användarupplevelse.
Förståelse för utvärdering av AI-lösningar, testramverk och ansvarsfulla AI-praktiker.
Kännedom om Microsofts AI-ekosystem, inklusive Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Power Automate och relaterade tjänster.
Stark förståelse för principer för mjukvaruteknik, designmönster, säkerhet och bästa utvecklingspraxis.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och samarbeta över flera discipliner.
Starka kommunikationsfärdigheter med förmåga att förklara tekniska koncept för både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper.
Förmåga att engagera sig direkt med kunder och förstå affärskrav.
Kandidatexamen i datavetenskap, datavetenskap, mjukvaruteknik, artificiell intelligens eller en närliggande disciplin. Alternativt motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet och dokumenterad teknisk förmåga

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av följande:

Vektordatabaser och teknologier för semantisk sökning.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-arkitekturer och företagskunskapssystem.
AI-orkestreringsramverk såsom Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, PromptFlow, Microsoft Agent Framework eller jämförbara teknologier.
Agentkommunikationsstandarder och protokoll såsom Model Context Protocol (MCP) och Agent-to-Agent (A2A).
AI workflow automation platformar som Power Automate, n8n, OpenAI Agent Builder, eller liknande verktyg.
Git-baserade utvecklingsarbetsflöden och CI/CD-pipelines.
Azure molntjänster och moderna applikationsimplementeringsmetoder.
Erfarenhet av AI-kodningsassistenter och utvecklarproduktivitetsverktyg.

Personliga projekt, bidrag till öppen källkod, forskning eller portföljarbete som involverar AI agenter, andrepiloter eller LLM-drivna applications.

Om Dig

Tycker om att experimentera, prototypa och omvandla innovativa idéer till praktiska lösningar.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.

What You'll Do

Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap

Who you are

You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.

You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments

Fluent
Swedish and English are both required for this role.

Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.

What You'll Gain

You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.

Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback

What this job actually looks like

Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require
. You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.

The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.

Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.

Why Intric

One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity
Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL
25 days paid vacation
Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

We're looking for hands-on Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.

Key responsibilities

Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack

About you

You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.

We're looking for someone who has:

A completed three-year bachelor's degree or a five-year master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field
At least 4 years of professional software development experience
Recent, hands-on experience building and owning backend services in a typed language — TypeScript, C#, Java, Go or similar
Professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
Strong backend proficiency, ideally with Node.js and Express.js
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases

High value if you also bring:

Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)

About Zendr

Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.

What we offer

Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
Work with a modern tech stack
High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth

Our hiring process

We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
Application review:
We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
First conversation:
An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
Coding assignment:
A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
Technical interview:
We'll spend the session with your coding assignment open. You'll make a small change to it on your own machine, using whatever tools you normally work with, and we'll talk through your reasoning, your design decisions and how you would take the solution further.
Final meeting:
Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.

From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

Additional information

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.
Start date:
As soon as possible
Scope:
Full-time, permanent position
Location:
Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

jobs.title: Solutions Architect - Nordics Fungible
jobs.description:
Req ID: FEQ327R409

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible
. Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.
Win the technical decision: demonstrate Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions in competitive, must-win scenarios.
Move fast while maintaining the bar: establish momentum quickly in ambiguous situations and compress timelines without cutting corners.
Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.
Scale: bring back patterns, plays, and product feedback that make every engagement after yours faster.

What We Look For

We care more about how you think and the impact you've had than about a specific checklist. You'll likely bring most of the following, and if you're missing one or two but bring something we haven't thought of, we still want to hear from you!

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with the ability to build, debug, and demonstrate working solutions live.
Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Nice to haves

Given our role in the Field Engineering organisation, we are always looking to expand the depth our team can offer with your areas of specialisation. Any of the following would be a valuable addition to the team!

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).
Familiarity with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) and how to position against them.
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider.
Depth in an industry vertical (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, and others).

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
