jobs.title: 3D Platform Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Hej 3D Platform Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.

We’re Looking For a 3D Platform Engineer To Build The Shared Capabilities Behind IKEA’s Next Generation Of 3D Digital Planning And Product Experiences. You Will Transform Complex CAD And PLM Product Data Into Reliable, Scalable 3D Assets And Services—covering Tessellation, Mesh Optimization, LOD Generation, And Preservation Of Visual And Geometric Fidelity. Your Work Will Make High-quality 3D Product Data Easier To Use Across Customer-facing Planning Solutions, Content Production, And Product Development. On a Typical Week, You Will

Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, C++, and Python.
Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well-defined development briefs.
Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
Build automated CAD-to-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
Develop and validate mesh-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
Benchmark and integrate commercial and open-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud-based 3D processing services.

Qualifications

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a 3D Platform Engineer, You Combine Strong Software Engineering With Practical Knowledge Of 3D Data, Pipelines, And Runtime Needs. You Can Work Across The Full Flow—from CAD And PLM Sources To Optimized Assets And Scalable Services. You Should Also Bring

A strong understanding of computer graphics, real-time and offline rendering, and production-ready 3D asset pipelines.
Hands-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
Knowledge of product-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business-critical services in an agile environment.
A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Strong C++ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third-party libraries.
Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.

Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.

It’s a Plus If You Also Bring

Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
Experience with mesh-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

Additional Information

Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.

Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking

Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Portfolio Analysis
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product and on capabilities used by investment professionals to understand portfolios, performance and risk.

In your daily work you will, together with your team, understand and review customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, Dyalog APL and Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend components, APIs and services.

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping parts of our product for the cloud. We are not modernizing for the sake of fashion. We are doing it because our products are business critical, widely used and need to keep evolving in a careful way.

AI Is Part Of How We Work Every Day

We use AI every day and see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. We actively look for ways to integrate AI into our work whenever it creates real benefit for our customers, products, teams or engineers. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work, explore alternatives and build better software.

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team and individual.

We encourage personal development, curiosity and experimentation. Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements, giving you regular opportunities to explore new technologies, improve something important, or try out ideas that may benefit you, your team or the application.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We are looking for a developer who enjoys real product engineering: understanding the problem, discussing trade-offs, writing good software, ensuring quality and improving the system over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to help lead beyond writing code. You will contribute to design discussions, help the team make good technical decisions, improve maintainability and performance, and support the software you help build.

Designing, developing and maintaining backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET
Working with Dyalog APL and other technologies where they are part of the product
Contributing to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value
Improving performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience
Using CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work
Using AI every day as part of practical engineering work, including exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, generating prototypes, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks
Working with the team to discover where AI can create real value in our development process and where human engineering judgment should lead
Collaborating with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software solutions
Supporting the team in continuously improving both the product and the way we work

What We Expect From You

We expect you to know some of the following and be able to, and interested in, learning the rest:

C# and .NET development
Backend development and API design
Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications
Continuous integration and delivery
Automated testing and practical quality engineering
Working with relational databases, such as Oracle or similar
Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services
A willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL
Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and how it can improve daily development work

Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important than your ability to learn, collaborate, and handle responsibilities.

We value people who are good at several of the following and interested in improving the rest:

Leading your work and achieving results
Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
Working with others to leverage the abilities of everyone in the team
Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
Looking continuously for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Comparing technical quality with business value
Using modern tools, especially AI tools, every day where they help us build better software and become better engineers
Contributing to an inclusive, trust-based and collaborative engineering culture

How We Work

We believe good software engineering is a team activity. Quality is not something handed over at the end. It is built into the way we discuss requirements, design solutions, write code, test, review, deploy and learn from production feedback.

We also believe senior engineers should have room to think. We do not expect you to chase every trend. We expect you to apply sound engineering judgment, use modern practices where they help, and help us evolve a large and widely used product in a way that is sustainable for clients, users and engineers.

AI is one of the modern practices we take seriously. We do not view AI as a separate area of engineering. We view it as another tool in the engineering toolbox. Just as we continuously adopted better testing, automation and cloud technologies, we expect AI to become a natural part of how we design, build, document, test, maintain and improve software.

Benefits

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we may ask you to provide feedback, which is highly appreciated.

(Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI)
to join our Innovation team. The role embeds with enterprise clients remotely, with onsite visits as engagements require.

Position Summary

Reporting to the VP, Innovation, Solution Delivery, the Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI) embeds with enterprise clients to design, build and operationalize agentic AI solutions in production. You will build production outcomes for clients, integrate agentic systems with enterprise platforms and systems of record, and stay accountable through cutover, early production and handover to ongoing support. The role is platform-agnostic by design and adapts to whichever AI platform best fits the client, including hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery, scope agentic AI use cases, and translate business problems into engineering deliverables with measurable success criteria such as cycle-time reduction, support deflection, automation rate, security and governance success rate and adoption rate.
Design target architectures that fit the client's environment, regulatory posture and platform preferences, selecting the right substrate per engagement across hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.
Write production-grade code to deliver the solution, working inside the client's source control, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure, and within enterprise release governance including change approvals, separation of duties, audit evidence and rollback planning.
Build and tune retrieval pipelines, prompt architecture, guardrails, agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls that hold under real production variation.
Implement enterprise-safe agent tool execution, including permission scoping, approval gates, audit trails and rollback paths for any agent action that touches systems of record.
Build evaluation suites that catch hallucinations, regressions, grounding gaps and quality drift, and implement production observability for latency, token usage, error rates, accuracy and output drift.
Integrate solutions with client identity, secrets management, network controls, incident response and compliance tooling.
Stay engaged through cutover and the first production iteration cycle, then run a structured handover to the ongoing support team, including documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
Act as an escalation backup to the support team after handover, stepping back in when issues exceed the support team's depth or when the system needs architectural intervention.
Build trusted advisor relationships with client engineering, data, security and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly to both engineering teams and C-level audiences.
Abstract field learnings into reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures that feed back into Innovation and shape product direction, methodology and the next engagement.

Experience

This is a Principal-level role. We are looking for engineers with the depth to operate independently inside enterprise client environments, the breadth to span production engineering and applied AI, and the demonstrated ability to ship in a discipline that is still being defined. We weight recent, hands-on agentic AI work heavily, recognising that production agentic systems are a young discipline. Equivalent experience from adjacent disciplines, including machine learning engineering, applied AI research with production deployment exposure, or senior backend engineering with recent agentic shipping, is welcomed.

8+ years of professional engineering experience across production systems, with significant production rather than purely advisory time.
2+ years shipping AI or machine learning systems into production, with demonstrated hands-on agentic or LLM-based work.
Proven track record working directly with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 enterprise clients in ambiguous, complex environments.
Track record of operating across the full lifecycle of a system, including architecture ownership, handover to support and ongoing escalation support.
Demonstrated ability to learn fast and ship in emerging technical disciplines. Candidates whose recent agentic AI work was learned quickly on the back of strong fundamentals are explicitly in scope.
Enterprise systems-of-record grounding: hands-on experience with an ERP we support (SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards), or strong business-process depth in core enterprise processes such as procurement, finance and order-to-cash. Direct SAP or Oracle E-Business Suite experience preferred.

Skills

ERP and enterprise systems experience across SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, infor, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday or other systems of record. Direct SAP and Oracle EBS experience highly valued. Required for ERP-anchored regional seats.
Experience with multiple agentic AI platforms, demonstrating ability to deliver on whichever platform the client has standardized on.
Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer or equivalent embedded delivery role at an AI lab, hyperscaler or systems integrator.
Production Python and at least one additional enterprise or full-stack language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, C# or Scala, including modern agent frameworks and patterns.
SQL and data modelling fluency, including the ability to reason about enterprise data quality, lineage, permissions and operational semantics.
Hands-on retrieval-augmented generation, including chunking, embeddings, vector stores and reranking.
Evaluation suite design for LLM-based systems, including regression detection, hallucination measurement and grounding checks.
Production observability for AI systems, including latency, token usage, error rate and output drift instrumentation.
Working knowledge of at least one major agentic AI platform such as AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, ServiceNow AI and willingness to learn others as engagements demand.
Agent tool execution and governance, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool interfaces, permission scoping, scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails and safe execution controls.
Enterprise integration fundamentals, including REST and event-driven patterns, identity flows such as OIDC and SAML, and secure deployment into client-controlled environments.
UI and front-end fluency in modern web frameworks such as Angular, React or equivalent, sufficient to build or extend the user-facing layer of agentic solutions.
Durable execution frameworks, event-driven architectures or workflow orchestration at enterprise scale.
Exceptional written and verbal communication across deep technical and executive audiences, with strong consultative and outcomes-driven instincts. High autonomy, resilience and pragmatism in legacy and politically complex environments, with the proactive discipline needed for effective remote embedding.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About The Role

Wiley is looking for a strong Solution Architect to join our ReX Review & Screening team in Iași, Romania. Research Exchange (ReX) is Wiley's publishing platform, built from components such as Review, Screening, and Commissions. As a Solution Architect, you will provide a holistic view of, and take ownership of, its infrastructure and supporting technologies, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and strategic direction for the long term in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective way. You'll partner closely with senior leaders, engineering and delivery teams, product managers, and development teams across these components to keep roadmaps aligned and guide well-considered technology decisions, all while remaining pragmatic.

Responsibilities

Provide a holistic view of, and ownership over, the platform's core and supporting technologies, building consensus on its future technical direction.
Make high-level technical decisions that influence all development teams, defining and communicating architectural solutions through code, where appropriate.
Understand the business context and vision for ReX, partnering with product teams to propose solutions that align with our direction.
Guide a cohesive technical direction across ReX's core components, helping each development team make well-aligned architectural choices as the platform evolves.
Lead scoping, architecture, and design across cloud and on-premises technologies, and drive multi-year architecture roadmaps.
Develop solutions using a cloud-first approach on AWS; establish strategies for secure identity, authentication, and authorization architectures; and lead security projects from conception through implementation.
Evaluate integration requirements for business solutions, ensuring adherence to architecture standards and information security policies.
Educate, support, and mentor development teams through training and hands-on collaboration, focusing on building the teams' own capabilities rather than creating dependency on you.
Continuously improve technical processes and practices, and implement quality assurance guidelines for testing, code quality, and deployment.
Stay ahead of industry trends, contribute to technology strategy and roadmaps, and maintain documentation of architectural decisions and standards.
Be part of the wider Research Architecture Group, contributing to pan-Wiley architecture policies, and conduct periodic skills gap analyses and training.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Degree in Computer Science or a related field (MSc preferred), or equivalent demonstrated experience; a minimum of 12 years in the software industry, including several years in an architecture or technical leadership capacity.
Proven track record in software and systems architecture and event-driven microservices, with deep expertise in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem and cloud-native technologies on AWS.

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise across our stack (Node.js, TypeScript, Express, React, and GraphQL), with a proven track record of architecting event-driven, service-based systems.
Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) running on AWS, as well as CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code practices.
Strong understanding of cloud delivery models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and observability and monitoring practices for distributed, service-based architectures.

Nice to Have

Experience with Agile and Lean methodologies; a strong grasp of clean code principles, continuous delivery, and managing technical debt.
Familiarity with GraphQL schema design and message/event-based integration patterns; AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect) is a plus.

Skills & Behaviors

Strong strategic planning, decision-making, and organizational skills; self-motivated, accountable, and able to influence and drive change across teams.
An analytical, flexible, and proactive problem-solver, comfortable managing both short-term deliverables and long-term goals.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership; works well independently and collaboratively at all levels.
An advanced level of English is required.

We power infinite possibilities.

For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well-being of all employees. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. The range below represents Wiley's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.

When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered.

We are looking for a Middle-Senior Backend Developer / Support Engineer to provide L2/L3 engineering support for SAP PowerDesigner. You will work in an English-speaking, distributed product-support organization serving SAP stakeholders and enterprise customers. Contribute focused feature and product-quality improvements

5-7 years of software development experience
Strong hands-on C# and .NET development skills
Practical C or C++ development and debugging experience
Solid SQL and relational database knowledge

Comfortable owning technical investigations end to end
PowerShell or VBScript scripting skills
Balances code quality with timely incident resolution
Familiarity with data-modelling tools and concepts

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst with .NET Background
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.

This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.

What You'll Be Doing

Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts
Support system integration analysis across applications, APIs, databases and external platforms
Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What You'll Bring Along

Bachelor’s degree in Informatics or similar field of study, or equivalent working experience
Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies
Experience with SQL Server, data modelling, database design concepts and data interfaces
Good understanding of REST APIs, application integrations and system data flows
Proven experience performing technical analysis, impact analysis and application reverse engineering
Strong experience with requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications
Experience documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, technical workflows and data mappings
Ability to facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams
Advanced knowledge of Agile / Scrum methodology
Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Confluence, Visio / Draw.io and SQL Server Management Studio
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills
Well-structured and organised working methodology
Excellent English verbal and written skills

jobs.title: .NET Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
About the Job

Company Description

OBSS is Turkey’s largest technology consultancy, pioneering product development and technology consulting for an AI-native future. With more than 20 years of experience and offices in London, Istanbul and Ankara, we empower leading companies in banking and finance, insurance, e-commerce, retail, and the start-up ecosystem. Our team of over 1000 talented professionals thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We are now looking for a .NET Full Stack Developer to join us and contribute to building high-quality, end-to-end solutions that create real business impact.

OBSS is looking for a .NET Full Stack Developer
to join our dynamic team and contribute to delivering end-to-end software payment solutions across diverse industries. You will work on cutting-edge projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality applications that solve real business problems.

Main Responsibilities

Collaborate with business analysts, project managers, and other stakeholders to understand and define project requirements.
Design, develop, and maintain .NET-based applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and security.
Participate in the full software development life cycle, including planning, coding, testing, and deployment.
Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and issues in a timely manner.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve development processes and technologies.

Qualifications / Technical Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or any relevant field.
Strong experience with .NET Core, C#, MVC, WebAPI, Entity Framework, and SQL
Knowledge of Angular
Knowledge of Kubernetes, MSSQL, Redis, and cloud platforms (GCP preferred)
Experience with test automation
Eager to learn new technologies
Good team player with a result-oriented attitude and analytical mindset
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
High energy and drive
Ability to approach AI with curiosity and intention, actively incorporating AI-powered tools into workflows to enhance productivity and drive innovation.

Additional Informations :

Professional Growth & Learning

As a tech company, we focus on reskilling and upskilling to support career growth. We offer a personalized Individual Growth Program (IGP), where employees set clear goals for each half of the year. These goals may include trainings, certifications, and personal development milestones, creating a structured roadmap for continuous improvement. The IGP helps employees strengthen both technical and soft skills, ensuring steady professional advancement.

Company Culture and Values

We celebrate diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation can flourish. Our culture emphasizes mentorship, knowledge sharing, and active participation in tech communities, workshops, and team events. This vibrant atmosphere empowers employees to contribute their best while feeling supported and valued.

Benefits and Perks

We provide competitive salaries, flexible and hybrid working arrangements, and a wide range of opportunities for growth through training programs, certifications, and workshops. In addition, we offer initiatives designed to build a supportive and engaging workplace where curiosity and collaboration are encouraged. These benefits ensure that employees feel motivated, empowered, and equipped to reach their full potential.

for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.

Aderis is building the next generation of enterprise software: an AI-native Finance ERP system designed from the ground up to leverage the power of artificial intelligence. .

We are looking for a Senior Developer to work on our multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform, used by HR teams and by employees across the organisations we work with. The role combines hands-on development with architectural decisions and code review, and carries direct ownership of the areas you work on.

Work in an agile environment, collaborating with product, data science and design.

How we work

AI tools support our developers in their day-to-day work and are integrated into how we build software. Keeping that setup growing is part of the team’s work and part of this role. If you are excited about AI and where it is heading, you will have room to run with it.

What you bring

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification
Substantial professional experience building and operating production web applications end to end (typically 5+ years)
Strong .NET and Entity Framework skills, with solid SQL Server experience
Extensive Angular experience
Proficiency with Git and a pull-request-based workflow
Demonstrated command of clean code, SOLID principles and testing methodology, with the ability to explain why, not only apply the rule

Tech stack

.NET 10 · Entity Framework · Angular 21 · Azure SQL Database · Azure (App Service, Managed Redis, Azure OpenAI, Key Vault, Storage) · Terraform · Playwright and xUnit · Azure DevOps · Claude Code

What we offer

Full-time contract in a growing, international scale-up
Fully remote within Spain or hybrid in Santander or Barcelona, whichever suits you
Flexible hours, Fridays until 3 pm and reduced summer hours
25 holidays plus 2 additional Personal Time Off days
One additional week of salary or holiday per three years with us
Career Path & Learning budget
Cobee & Wellhub

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

POSITION DETAILS

Location:
Sant Cugat del Vallès (Barcelona), Spain — hybrid.
Contract:
permanent, full-time.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger- and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018 - and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco - we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Software Architect / Solutions Architect
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the overall system architecture
for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping our technology strategy, evaluating new tools and frameworks, and ensuring best practices
in software design, cloud infrastructure, and system integration.

Responsibilities

Define and maintain the overall architecture and system design for scalable and efficient software solutions.
Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, guiding them in best practices for architecture, coding, and system scalability.
Design and document high-level system diagrams, data flows, and API structures.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and cloud services to optimize performance, security, and cost-efficiency.
Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and security in all architectural decisions.
Oversee system integrations, including microservices, APIs, and third-party services.
Work closely with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure smooth deployment and operational reliability.
Establish coding and architecture standards, ensuring maintainability and scalability of codebases.
Identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring system resilience and future scalability.
Conduct architecture reviews and performance audits to continuously improve system efficiency.

Requirements

Around 6+ years of experience in software development and architecture.
Strong expertise in system design, cloud computing, and microservices architecture.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and cloud-native architectures.
Proficiency in backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, .NET) and experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue).
Knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching strategies, and data pipelines.
Experience with event-driven architectures, API design, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong understanding of security best practices, identity management, and encryption techniques.
Ability to evaluate trade-offs in architectural decisions, balancing scalability, cost, and complexity.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What benefits do we offer?

Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
Annual Bonus
Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
Childcare support.
Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
Meals 100% free at the hub.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Team Assure
jobs.description:
Signicat is a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider, supporting over 170 data sources for seamless identity verification. Trusted by governments, financial institutions, and businesses worldwide. Such as General Financing, Compensa Life, Telia, Rimi, Volvo, and many more.

Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale.

Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world.

Since 2007, Signicat has been steadily growing organically and through strategic acquisitions, which led us to become a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider (DISP). We support 170+ data sources to identify businesses and individuals – from national eIDs, ID-document scanning, and biometric verification to data sources for AML and KYC checks, all accessible through a single integration point.

The Role

As a hands-on Engineering Manager, you will combine Java programming with engineering and technical leadership for one of our teams working in the domain of Identity Proofing. You will be responsible for growing and supporting the team, driving delivery, prioritizing the roadmap and backlog together with the Product Owner and other stakeholders, and balancing new capabilities with reliability, operational excellence, and technical debt.

The team is currently working on Signicat's next-generation offering for Identity Proofing by orchestrating several means available in the Signicat portfolio, such as NFC chip reading and live video identifications, in order to satisfy the highest compliance requirements in the market for financial services and similar.

How You'll Make An Impact

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive the evolution of Signicat's Identity Proofing platform, ensuring it remains secure, scalable, reliable, and ready for future growth.
Collaborate closely with architects, engineering teams, and stakeholders across the company to deliver capabilities that satisfy ever-changing market needs.
Guide architectural and technical decisions within the team while promoting engineering best practices, observability, automation, and operational excellence.

Why We'll Love You

You are an experienced engineering leader who enjoys building high-performing teams as much as building great technology.
You have a strong software engineering background and are comfortable discussing architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms with experienced engineers.
You thrive at the intersection of engineering and product, translating business needs into technical priorities and delivery plans.
You are an excellent communicator who builds trusted relationships with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders alike.
You bring deep expertise in the Java ecosystem, enabling you to provide strong technical leadership, mentor developers, and guide architectural decisions for high-scale SaaS services.
You enjoy coaching others, creating clarity, and enabling teams to do their best work.

Why You'll Love Working at Signicat

We Are Committed To Creating a Supportive, Inclusive, And Empowering Environment Where You Can Do Your Best Work And Grow Your Career. We Offer

Exceptional Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 5 paid days off each year on top of your 25 annual holiday allowance, plus a flexible, hybrid work schedule that trusts you to manage your time.
Estoril: Modern workplace - our residential-style Estoril office, conveniently near a train station, blends a relaxed seaside ambience with a cosy, tech-filled workspace. Featuring chill-out zones, a garden, and proximity to the beach, it's the perfect place to work and unwind
Work from Anywhere: Experience our international culture firsthand with the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and from any European country for 3 weeks per year.
Continuous Growth: We invest in your development with 2 hours of dedicated learning time each week, quarterly development talks, and clear career paths.
Health & Wellness: We support your well-being with a dedicated wellness package and complimentary access to the Headspace app for mental health and mindfulness.
Your Tech, Your Way: Choose the laptop and tech gear that you are most comfortable and productive with.
A Truly International Team: Join a diverse and welcoming community with active Employee Resource Groups, including Women in Signicat and our LGBTQ+ group.

We're a dynamic community of passionate professionals dedicated to digital identity solutions.

Since our founding, we have grown and evolved through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, and continuous innovations.

This makes Signicat an exciting and ever-changing environment to be a part of!

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

We are seeking a highly consultative Staff Solutions Architect
to support our most important customers. This role is a critical technical position, spanning both product development and pre and post sales customer motions.

You will act as a trusted technical lead and thought leader, partnering closely with Account Executives, Post Sales, and Product teams to drive measurable business and technical value through

High priority customer technical leadership
Docker field technical leadership

This role reports to the Director of Solutions Architecture and operates at the intersection of technical depth, business acumen, and thought leadership.

Responsibilities

High priority customer technical leadership

Work with Docker’s most important customers and cross functional Docker teams to accelerate the customer’s container and AI journeys, focusing on developer workflows
Engage with customer teams and cross functional Docker teams to gather customer’s technical/business goals and challenges related to their container and AI journey.
Create and manage engagement plans that span existing products and new Docker offerings to achieve critical business goals.
Oversee “design partner” rapid prototyping engagements with Docker engineering and customer teams to validate customer-product fit for new use cases
Work with Docker teams to create/manage/deliver custom demos and content aligned to customer use cases.
Deliver high-impact enablement and best practices content to customer audiences from developer to C level.
Ability to travel up to 50% internationally as a senior representative of Docker to prospective clients, customers, and technical alliance partners.

Docker field technical leadership (regional/area of responsibility)

Be a thought leader for a particular area of responsibility both internal and external to Docker, working with fellow Dockhands to create/manage/deliver content
Gather field feedback from customer teams and Docker pre and post sales teams
Coordinate with Field CTO and other Solutions Architects to prioritize/contextualize/correlate field requests into a cohesive set of prioritized requests to the product/engineering teams.
Work directly with Docker product/engineering teams on workflows and feature alignment to customer use cases prioritized by revenue impact.
Be customer zero for new functionality produced by Docker product/engineering teams
Give input on internal technical enablement and customer enablement needs, and review enablement content
Assist the sales enablement team with internal technical enablement for new products and services.

Qualifications

Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solution Architect in complex enterprise environments.
Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in managing customer relationships at the technical and business level.
Experience presenting solutions and demonstrations to small and large audiences, virtually and in person.
Experience interfacing with internal product/software teams, including technical support, product, and engineering, to enhance documentation, enablement, and product features to improve customer experience and enablement.
Experience developing application code, and a clear understanding of the challenges developers experience on a daily basis.
Ability to solve technical problems and translate customer experience to actionable feedback for engineering.
Experience developing collateral to assist customers with best-practice adoption.
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containers, DevOps, and modern application architectures.
Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies strongly preferred.
Development, Agentic AI dev, Software Development Lifecycle and/or Software Supply Chain Security experience strongly preferred.
Must be fluent in English
Willingness to travel up to 50% internationally as a senior representative of Docker to prospective clients, customers, and technical alliance partners.

What to expect

First 30 days

You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program
You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as; Salesforce, Outreach, Sigma, and Opine.
Actively engage with senior stakeholders, and manage relationships with clients
You will work closely with your peers and shadow customer meetings to develop strategies to advocate for our customers.
At the end of your first month, you will have a proficient grasp of the tools and activities necessary to be successful in your role.

First 60 days

You will be laser-focused on supporting the sales and customer success teams during your second month.
You will have connected with all of your team members.
You will gain in-depth knowledge of Docker’s products and how they impact our customers.
You will have an advanced understanding of tools, activities, and best practices to be successful in your role.

First 90 days

In month three, you will be confident in your craft and ready to immerse yourself in our customer’s business needs fully.
You will continue efforts to improve messaging, processes, and activities.
Educate our clients about our product roadmap and undertake product training for users
You will be ready to operate independently at full speed.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

EU:
€141,400K – €202K + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.
Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.
Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.
Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

As an HMI and SCADA Software Engineer
at INNIO, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining modern HMI/SCADA software solutions, including both front-end and back-end components. You will work on secure, reliable, and maintainable systems, support customization through reusable templates and scripts, and collaborate with product management, end users, and validation teams to deliver high-quality solutions. In addition, you will provide troubleshooting and remote support for field systems, maintain technical documentation, and contribute within agile development processes such as SCRUM.

At INNIO We Offer You

Young & supportive team - in a fast-growing international business environment
Learn & develop yourself - help you craft your career path with (INNIO learning, free language courses according to business needs
Hybrid working - 50% Office, 50 % Home Office with flexible working hours
Cafeteria package with various options - SZÉP Card, Cash option, Nursery & kindergarten support
Medicover Spring White Package- from the first day of employment
Easily accessible location - in the heart of the most vibrant campus area in Budapest (location: 13rd District, easy to approach by Metro Line 3)
Take a break - Recharge your batteries with free coffee and tea selection in the kitchen area
Live an active lifestyle - activate your AYCM pass

Your Responsibilities

Design and develop front-end and back-end software components for INNIO HMI/SCADA systems using modern web technologies.
Architect highly available, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
Create reusable templates and scripts to streamline order-specific customizations and boost productivity.
Execute projects in alignment with the INNIO Jenbacher design process and agile methodologies (e.g., SCRUM).
Collaborate closely with product line management and end users to gather and analyze requirements.
Maintain and update software, providing timely field updates as needed.
Provide troubleshooting and third-level remote support for INNIO HMI/SCADA systems in the field.
Develop comprehensive technical documentation and user manuals.
Plan and conduct software validation activities in cooperation with validation engineers.

Your Profile

Bachelor or Masters degree in computing science, informatics, mechatronic or electrical engineering or equivalent
Fluent English and Hungarian communication skills (both written and spoken) German or any other language is a plus.
5+ years of experience and strong interest in WEB development (HTML 5, Type Script, Java Script, React or Angular JS) or .NET C#
Basic knowledge in Linux, Docker, CI/CD, agile development, GIT, Azure DevOps
Basic knowledge in SQL or Influx database design

jobs.description:
Job Description

Purpose

The Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining enterprise applications and integrations within IHS’s digital ecosystem. Reporting to the Senior Manager, EA, the role involves full-stack development using React and .NET Core APIs, cloud-native data management with SQL Azure and Azure Cosmos DB, and deployment and operations on Microsoft Azure infrastructure.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain web applications using React (frontend) and .NET Core API (backend), ensuring high performance and scalability.
Build and maintain data models, schemas, and stored procedures in SQL Azure; design and manage collections in Azure Cosmos DB.
Design and implement integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using REST APIs, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management.
Deploy, configure, and manage application infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, etc.).
Contribute to architecture reviews and technical design decisions; participate in sprint planning and agile ceremonies.
Monitor application performance, investigate and resolve production issues, and implement preventive improvements.
Maintain and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps; follow DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code best practices.
Apply security best practices across all application layers including authentication, authorization, and data protection.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, operations, and vendors to deliver high-quality solutions.

Job-Specific Competencies

Full-Stack Development – Proficiency in React and .NET Core for building responsive, scalable enterprise applications.
Cloud Engineering – Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Data Management – Experience with relational (SQL Azure) and NoSQL (Cosmos DB) databases in production environments.
Integration Design – Ability to design and implement system integrations using REST APIs, messaging, and event-driven patterns.
DevOps Practices – Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, and infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/ARM templates).
Security Awareness – Understanding of cloud security principles, identity management (Azure AD/Entra ID), and secure coding practices.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Experience

Minimum 3–5 years of software development experience in a professional environment.
Proven hands-on experience with React and .NET Core API development.
Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with SQL Azure (relational) and Azure Cosmos DB (NoSQL) in production systems.
Experience with RESTful API design, system integration patterns, and enterprise application development.
Microsoft Azure certification (e.g., AZ-204 Developer Associate or AZ-900) preferred.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Deep knowledge of React component architecture, hooks, and state management (Redux / Context API).
Strong knowledge of .NET Core, C#, and RESTful API design principles including authentication (OAuth 2.0, Azure AD/Entra ID).
Knowledge of Azure PaaS services: App Services, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
Understanding of database design, query optimization, and data modeling in both SQL Azure and Cosmos DB.
Familiarity with microservices architecture, event-driven design, and enterprise integration patterns
Proficient in React, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Proficient in C# and .NET Core, including Entity Framework Core and middleware patterns.
Skilled in Azure portal, Azure DevOps, and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Bicep / ARM templates).
Ability to write clean, maintainable, testable code and conduct meaningful code reviews.
Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance-tuning skills.
Must have: Experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) for AI-assisted software development.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional, agile delivery teams and take end-to-end ownership of features.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and deliver within sprint timelines.
Strong communication skills – able to articulate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to adapt quickly to evolving requirements, new Azure services, and emerging technologies.

Additional Information

Organizational Competencies

Customer Focus
- People demonstrating this competency understand & exceed our customers’ needs. They develop trusted, reliable & collaborative relationships. They are consistently operating to the highest standards of service & delivery.

Innovation
- People demonstrating this competency constantly seek new & improved ways to deliver our products & services. They champion engineering & skills development, and work to create a collaborative and supportive operating environment.

Integrity
- People demonstrating this competency are open & honest in everything they do. They support financially & environmentally sustainable growth. They make socially responsible decisions and treat their stakeholders with respect.

Be Bold
- People demonstrating this competency are thorough in analyses & decision-making. They are courageous in expanding existing markets & developing new ones. They confidently pursue appropriate financial returns and are forward-thinking and ambitious.

Sustainability
- People demonstrating this competency are constantly seeking to create positive impact in the communities we serve.

Our Vision

IHS is committed to improving the quality and availability of telecommunications infrastructure, the lifeline for an increasingly connected world. We are dedicated to helping create a sustainable future for the communities in which we operate, and our sustainable strategy is structured around four pillars: ethics and governance, environment and climate change, education and economic growth, and our people and communities.

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET Ontwikkelaar
new_jobs.description:
AI schrijft steeds meer van onze code. Daarom zoekt BKR een ervaren .NET-ontwikkelaar die ziet wanneer die code klopt en wanneer niet.

Je komt in het team Development, dat de ICT-oplossingen van BKR van begin tot eind bouwt. BKR heeft Development, infra- en Cloud-architectuur, testautomatisering en business informatie analyse in huis. De teams werken T-shaped: je hebt je eigen specialisme en schakelt makkelijk met de andere disciplines.

Je werkt in een BizDevOps-team volgens Agile en Scrum, samen met business informatie analisten, testspecialisten en operations. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt onze kernapplicaties in C# en .NET, met SQL Server en Entity Framework. Voor moderne webinterfaces zetten we in op Blazor. Onze applicaties draaien in een moderne Azure Cloud-omgeving, waarbij CI/CD en geautomatiseerde deployments de standaard zijn. Denk aan EVA, de Externe Verwijzings Applicatie waarmee BKR fraudepreventie faciliteert voor de NVB en VFN, en VIS, het Verificatie Identificatie Systeem waarmee organisaties identiteits- en reisdocumenten op geldigheid controleren.

AI-tools horen bij het werk. Je gebruikt onder meer GitHub Copilot om sneller te bouwen. Het verschil zit erin dat je snapt wat er uitkomt en waar het misgaat. Jij houdt overzicht over de architectuur en bewaakt de kwaliteit.

Wat je gaat doen

Softwarecomponenten bouwen op basis van requirement-, ontwerp- en architectuurdocumenten
Code schrijven voor system services, applicaties en moderne Blazor webinterfaces in C# en .NET
Aanpassingen integreren in bestaande applicaties
Onze CI/CD deployment pipelines inrichten, optimaliseren en onderhouden
Applicaties deployen, monitoren en beheren binnen de Azure Cloud-omgeving
Unit- en integratietesten uitvoeren en issues oplossen
Tweedelijns incident- en problemsupport leveren
Meedraaien in refinements, sprint planningen, reviews en retrospectives
AI inzetten waar het helpt, zonder het overzicht te verliezen

Wat we van je vragen

HBO werk- en denkniveau
5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als .NET-ontwikkelaar met C#, SQL Server en Entity Framework
Ervaring met Azure Cloud-architectuur en het opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD deployment pipelines (bijvoorbeeld via Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions)
Ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties in Blazor is een pre
Thuis in Agile, Scrum en het werken in BizDevOps-teams
Je werkt dagelijks met AI-coding assistants en weet waar hun grenzen liggen
Je blijft leren, juist nu AI veel werk overneemt. Vragen we hoe je jezelf scherp houdt en waar je je kennis vandaan haalt, dan heb je daar een goed antwoord op
Een ontwikkelaar die zijn mond opendoet. Je spreekt tegen als iets niet klopt en je vertaalt technische keuzes naar taal die het management snapt
Je hebt oog voor informatiebeveiliging. Bij ons hoort dat erbij, want we beheren gevoelige data
Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is een vereiste. Onze voertaal is Nederlands.

Een 13e maand

Stichting BKR is een databedrijf zonder winstoogmerk dat zich inzet voor de financiële gezondheid van Nederland. Wij beheren de kredietregistratie: alle kredietaanbieders melden hun leningen bij ons.
