new_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Willis Re is building its global technology estate from the ground up, unencumbered by legacy and designed around data, analytics and modern cloud platforms. We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the products that power our reinsurance broking, analytics and client-facing platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across the whole stack and is equally comfortable building conventional services and AI-enabled features. You will work alongside architects, product stakeholders and delivery partners to ship software that brokers and analysts use every day.

Key Responsibilities

Build Across the Stack: Design, build and ship features end to end, from APIs and services through to responsive, accessible user interfaces.
Cloud Native Delivery: Develop and run cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, using PaaS services, containers and infrastructure-as-code.
Data-Driven Features: Consume data through APIs and services to surface it in usable, performant ways for brokers and analysts.
AI-Enabled Development: Build AI-enabled product features using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and API integration, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Claude Cowork as part of your day-to-day workflow, and help the wider team adopt them well.
Integration: Integrate with external market platforms, carrier and client systems, and vendor SaaS products using API-first and event-driven patterns.
Quality & Security: Practise test-driven development and write secure, maintainable code, applying established security patterns including authentication and authorisation (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0), data protection and privacy from the start.
Collaboration: Build to the agreed architectural standards and help shape them, contributing to design discussions, reviewing code from in-house and partner engineers, and mentoring others across a greenfield estate.

About You

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys a fast-moving, greenfield environment and wants to work across both traditional and AI-native development. Ideally you will bring:

Experience: Extensive experience of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production systems end to end. Experience in insurance, reinsurance or wider financial services is a plus, but not essential.
Backend: Strong programming skills in C#/.NET or Python, with solid API design and strong SQL.
Frontend: Practical experience building modern user interfaces with React or Angular and TypeScript.
Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Standards & Security: Experience building to architectural standards and applying common patterns such as microservices, event-driven and API-led design, together with a strong grounding in security patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Entra ID, RBAC) and secure coding practices.
Data: Comfortable working with relational databases and data-heavy application features, with strong SQL and an eye for query performance.
AI Development: Experience building with LLMs and AI-enabled solutions, or a clear appetite to learn. Familiarity with agentic patterns, prompt design and evaluation is a significant advantage.
Engineering Craft: Fluency in test-driven development and automated testing, an eye for maintainable design, and good judgement about when to keep things simple.
Communication: Ability to work closely with product stakeholders and delivery partners, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly.

About Willis Re

We combine specialist broking with analytics, modeling and research to help insurers optimize risk transfer, strengthen balance sheets and achieve sustainable growth. Our approach is relationship-driven, transparent and outcome-focused.

At the heart of Willis Re is a focus on delivering the most cutting-edge analytical solutions to enable more informed, better decision-making for risk selection, portfolio optimization, and capital management.

The launch of Willis Re brings a strategic advantage of being unhindered by legacy, an ability to leverage data, statistical models and advanced technologies with the best knowledge and expertise to deliver more efficient and effective reinsurance outcomes. This places Willis Re in a unique position to build a truly analytically driven business, focused on creating solutions for the reinsurance industry that are future led and forward thinking.

Willis Re will also leverage recognized technical expertise from WTW’s Insurance Consulting & Technology business including their advanced modeling and analytical capabilities. Alongside this will be WTW’s Research Network, an award-winning business supporting and influencing science to improve the understanding and quantification of risk.

Willis Re is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive, and flexible work environment. We provide equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability, orientation, or any other legally protected categories. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please email us at talentacquisition@willisre.com

Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.

What You'll Do

Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap

Who you are

You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.

You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments

Fluent
Swedish and English are both required for this role.

Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.

What You'll Gain

You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.

Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback

What this job actually looks like

Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require
. You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.

The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.

Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.

Why Intric

One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously

Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL

Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

new_jobs.title: Backend Developer (.NET & C++)
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are looking for a Middle-Senior Backend Developer / Support Engineer to provide L2/L3 engineering support for SAP PowerDesigner. You will investigate complex customer issues, debug and maintain backend components, develop and validate hotfixes, perform root-cause analysis, and contribute targeted product improvements in a long-term enterprise support environment.

You will work in an English-speaking, distributed product-support organization serving SAP stakeholders and enterprise customers. The role combines hands-on backend development with operational support: incident ownership, customer-focused investigation, maintenance engineering, and continuous improvement. Collaboration will span development, support leadership, architecture, and service delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

Analyze and resolve L2/L3 product incidents
Reproduce issues and perform structured root-cause analysis
Debug C#/.NET and C/C++ components
Develop, test, and validate hotfixes and maintenance changes
Investigate customer-reported defects and performance issues
Document findings, fixes, and reusable troubleshooting guidance
Contribute focused feature and product-quality improvements

What You'll Bring Along

BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
5-7 years of software development experience
Strong hands-on C# and .NET development skills
Practical C or C++ development and debugging experience
Solid SQL and relational database knowledge
Experience with SAP PowerDesigner
Comfortable owning technical investigations end to end
PowerShell or VBScript scripting skills
Balances code quality with timely incident resolution
Familiarity with data-modelling tools and concepts
Communicates clearly with customers and distributed teams
Enterprise software or product-support experience
Works effectively as an individual contributor
Experience supporting long-lived desktop or backend products
Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Good written and spoken English communication skills

new_jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst with .NET Background
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.

This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.

What You'll Be Doing

Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts
Support system integration analysis across applications, APIs, databases and external platforms
Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What You'll Bring Along

Bachelor’s degree in Informatics or similar field of study, or equivalent working experience
Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies
Experience with SQL Server, data modelling, database design concepts and data interfaces
Good understanding of REST APIs, application integrations and system data flows
Proven experience performing technical analysis, impact analysis and application reverse engineering
Strong experience with requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications
Experience documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, technical workflows and data mappings
Ability to facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams
Advanced knowledge of Agile / Scrum methodology
Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Confluence, Visio / Draw.io and SQL Server Management Studio
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills
Well-structured and organised working methodology
Excellent English verbal and written skills

Keytrade Bank is a young bank, where IT systems traditionally were all developed in house. Currently we are moving to a model where we focus on customer experience and innovative products, relying more and more on off-the-shelf products and services for the basic functionality. Where in the past, responsibilities were organized by technical competences, we now are organizing them per business domain, called Feature Team.
The creation of new products requires strong interaction between all IT fields: the back-end; the front-end, database, infrastructure, vendors and service providers.
Working in a small bank is very different than working in a big bank. Responsibilities are greater, knowledge broader. We have a very high growth rate and we are looking for motivated people willing to become part of our dynamic teams to help improve and transform its existing trading and banking system.
Currently we are refactoring our core systems and transforming them in micro services deployed on AWS following Domain Driven Design principles.
Today we are looking for an Back-end C#. Net
to join our team. Are you ready for a new challenge?
Responsibilities

You are a team player, always ready to share and discuss ideas in order to improve the existing, and to find solution for new projects. Everyone is acknowledged for their role, and we need people with a strong sense of responsibility in our teams.
You are able to work independently when needed, dealing with tasks from early requirements analysis until final implementation and testing. You are open to interaction with your colleagues, able to reach out for help when required and open to accept or provide constructive criticism. You are eager to learn about trading and banking related matters, and also about new technologies. When it comes to programming, you are meticulous and orderly, without losing your pragmatic attitude.
You will be joining the OPPA Feature Team, responsible for Onboarding, Prospects, Personal Data Management and Access Management
.

In the coming years, one of the team’s major initiatives will be to make the client onboarding experience smoother, more efficient and more user-friendly, both on mobile and web. This is a key project for the team, with a strong impact on the digital journey of future Keytrade clients.
You will work closely with frontend and backend developers, business analysts, DevOps engineers, testers, a product owner and a scrum master. , una empresa tecnológica española fundada en 2003, con sede corporativa en León y oficinas en Valladolid, Madrid, y Londres. Hemos participado en más de 500 proyectos para organizaciones líderes en banca, seguros, telecomunicaciones, energía y salud a nivel internacional.

. Somos más de 140 personas con pasión por el software de alta complejidad técnica, por aprender continuamente y por trabajar en proyectos con impacto real. Trabajamos con marcos de trabajo ágiles e integramos la IA
como herramienta cotidiana, con un enfoque ético y responsable. Contamos con el respaldo tecnológico de Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Atlassian y OutSystems
, y con 6 certificaciones ISO que avalan nuestros procesos.

No es casualidad: llevamos 23 años demostrando que desde aquí se puede trabajar para el mundo.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos Senior .NET Engineer
para trabajar en un entorno en continua mejora y evolución tecnológica en León o Valladolid.

Tu día a día se desarrollará en un contexto de vanguardia:

Spec-Driven Development (SDD):
antes de escribir código, definimos lo que el sistema debe hacer. En este rol elaborarás especificaciones detalladas (requisitos funcionales, arquitectura y comportamiento esperado) antes de codificar.
Desarrollo asistido por IA:
uso habitual de Visual Studio / VS Code con Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor o similares en todo el ciclo, con criterio para evaluar lo que generan.
IA agéntica y Claude Skills:
usarás Claude Skills y MCP en el ciclo de desarrollo.
DevOps y CI/CD:
pipelines automatizados (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) y mejora constante del ciclo de entrega.
Stack tecnológico:
el lenguaje es lo de menos… En este proyecto: C#, .NET (8 o superior), ASP.NET Core (Web API), Entity Framework Core, SQL Server y Microsoft Azure, además de la evolución de aplicaciones en .NET Framework.
Calidad:
responsable de la calidad de tu código y referencia para el equipo: pruebas unitarias, de integración y funcionales (xUnit/NUnit), Clean Code, SOLID y code reviews.
Infraestructura como código:
Terraform, Ansible o Bicep.

¿Qué perfil necesitamos?

Formación:
Grado en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.
Experiencia:
al menos 3 años desarrollando software con tecnologías .NET en proyectos reales, con capacidad para afrontar retos complejos de forma autónoma.
Skills técnicos:
C# y .NET moderno, APIs REST con ASP.NET Core, EF Core y SQL; patrones de diseño, POO, Clean Code y SOLID.
SDD:
capacidad para elaborar especificaciones detalladas antes de codificar.
Desarrollo asistido por IA:
uso habitual y con criterio de modelos de lenguaje, evaluando críticamente el código generado.
IA agéntica y Claude Skills:
conocimiento práctico de Skills y MCP.
Mentalidad ágil:
experiencia en Scrum/Kanban.

¿Qué habilidades adicionales pueden sumar valor a tu perfil?

Blazor o frameworks front-end (Angular, React).
Microservicios, mensajería (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ) y contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes).
Migración de .NET Framework (incluido VB.NET) a .NET moderno.
Certificaciones Microsoft (p. ej., Azure Developer Associate).
Capacidad para desenvolverte con soltura en inglés, abriendo puertas a proyectos y colaboraciones internacionales.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

🚀 Proyectos de alta complejidad técnica:
trabajamos en problemas de alta complejidad técnica para clientes muy exigentes. No es para todo el mundo, y eso también es parte de lo que nos define.
🤝 El equipo, primero:
el nivel técnico de las personas con las que trabajarás es, probablemente, lo primero que nota quien llega. Aprenderás de tus compañeros/as porque saben más que tú en algo, y ellos aprenderán de ti en otra cosa. Esa densidad técnica no es casual.
💡 Siempre a la última, antes que el resto:
no llegamos a las tecnologías cuando ya son mainstream. Las adoptamos, las debatimos y las aplicamos en proyectos reales antes que la mayoría. Si tienes curiosidad técnica, aquí siempre hay algo nuevo en lo que crecer.
⚡ Sin jerarquías, sin intermediarios:
somos una empresa sin jerarquías. Las decisiones se toman con las personas adecuadas, de forma directa y sin intermediarios.
🧠 IA como ventaja, no como moda:
incorporamos inteligencia artificial de forma práctica en nuestros proyectos y en nuestra forma de trabajar. Tendrás acceso a herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude, formación real sobre cómo usarlas con criterio y la posibilidad de contribuir a proyectos donde la IA no es un extra, sino parte del núcleo.
🕐 Flexibilidad que se cumple:
horario flexible y modelo híbrido. Jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año, más julio y agosto completos. 22 días de vacaciones, y el 24 y el 31 de diciembre libres, siempre.
💰 Retribución competitiva:
salario alineado con el mercado y revisado según tu evolución real. Retribución flexible en restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación para que optimices lo que más te conviene.
🩺 Salud y bienestar:
seguro médico y dental, plan corporate en centros deportivos y torneos internos para los que quieran competir o simplemente desconectar.
🎁 Y los detalles también importan:
Welcome pack, cesta de Navidad, eventos de equipo y portal de descuentos exclusivo.

Nuestro compromiso:
tendrás respuesta en menos de una semana, independientemente del resultado.

Salario
: 28.000€ - 40.000€

Conseguir todo esto hace que trabajar en Xeridia sea una experiencia apasionante
¡Únete a nuestro equipo!

En Xeridia, promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y nos comprometemos a crear un entorno libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de empleo se basan en las necesidades de la empresa, los requisitos del puesto, los méritos y las cualificaciones individuales.

The Role

As a Software Architect / Solutions Architect
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the overall system architecture
for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping our technology strategy, evaluating new tools and frameworks, and ensuring best practices
in software design, cloud infrastructure, and system integration.

Responsibilities

Define and maintain the overall architecture and system design for scalable and efficient software solutions.

Establish coding and architecture standards, ensuring maintainability and scalability of codebases.

Around 6+ years of experience in software development and architecture.
Strong expertise in system design, cloud computing, and microservices architecture.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and cloud-native architectures.
Proficiency in backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, .NET) and experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue).
Knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching strategies, and data pipelines.
Experience with event-driven architectures, API design, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong understanding of security best practices, identity management, and encryption techniques.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Signicat is a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider, supporting over 170 data sources for seamless identity verification. Trusted by governments, financial institutions, and businesses worldwide. Such as General Financing, Compensa Life, Telia, Rimi, Volvo, and many more.

Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale.

Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world.

Since 2007, Signicat has been steadily growing organically and through strategic acquisitions, which led us to become a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider (DISP). We support 170+ data sources to identify businesses and individuals – from national eIDs, ID-document scanning, and biometric verification to data sources for AML and KYC checks, all accessible through a single integration point.

The Role

As a hands-on Engineering Manager, you will combine Java programming with engineering and technical leadership for one of our teams working in the domain of Identity Proofing. You will be responsible for growing and supporting the team, driving delivery, prioritizing the roadmap and backlog together with the Product Owner and other stakeholders, and balancing new capabilities with reliability, operational excellence, and technical debt.

The team is currently working on Signicat's next-generation offering for Identity Proofing by orchestrating several means available in the Signicat portfolio, such as NFC chip reading and live video identifications, in order to satisfy the highest compliance requirements in the market for financial services and similar.

How You'll Make An Impact

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive the evolution of Signicat's Identity Proofing platform, ensuring it remains secure, scalable, reliable, and ready for future growth.
Collaborate closely with architects, engineering teams, and stakeholders across the company to deliver capabilities that satisfy ever-changing market needs.
Guide architectural and technical decisions within the team while promoting engineering best practices, observability, automation, and operational excellence.

Why We'll Love You

You are an experienced engineering leader who enjoys building high-performing teams as much as building great technology.
You have a strong software engineering background and are comfortable discussing architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms with experienced engineers.
You thrive at the intersection of engineering and product, translating business needs into technical priorities and delivery plans.
You are an excellent communicator who builds trusted relationships with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders alike.
You bring deep expertise in the Java ecosystem, enabling you to provide strong technical leadership, mentor developers, and guide architectural decisions for high-scale SaaS services.
You enjoy coaching others, creating clarity, and enabling teams to do their best work.

Why You'll Love Working at Signicat

We Are Committed To Creating a Supportive, Inclusive, And Empowering Environment Where You Can Do Your Best Work And Grow Your Career. We Offer

Exceptional Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 5 paid days off each year on top of your 25 annual holiday allowance, plus a flexible, hybrid work schedule that trusts you to manage your time.

We're a dynamic community of passionate professionals dedicated to digital identity solutions.

Since our founding, we have grown and evolved through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, and continuous innovations.
